298 FISSURES—FISTULA

Paeonia off. (tds) : Hemorrhoids and fissures of anus together.
 Ulceration of anus and perineum, covered with
 crusts.
Petroleum (tds) : Chaps and fissures which bleed easily, worse
 in winter specially on the tips of fingers.
Platinum met. (tds) : Crawling and itching in anus.
Ranunculus bulb. (tds) : Finger tips and palms chapped. Blister-like
 eruptions on the palms.
Ratanhia (tds) : Sensation as if broken pieces of glass were in
 the anus. Anus burns for hours after stool.
 Fetid, thin diarrhea. Hemorrhoids burn.
 Fissures in the anus, with great constriction,
 burning like fire; temporarily relieved by cold
 water.
Sarsaparilla (tds) : Fissures on the skin of hands and feet. Deep
 cracks on fingers and toes.
Sedum acre (tds) : Fissures of the anus and hemorrhoids together.
Silicea (tds) : Fissures on finger tips and anus.

 FISTULA
 (ABNORMAL PASSAGE)

 Biliary
 fistula
 Vesico-vaginal fistula following
 following Gastrocolic fistula in radionecrosis in treatment of
 operation Crohn’s disease cancer of cervix

Bacillinum 200 (hs) : It may be given when other well selected
 remedies fail to cure.
 FISTULA—FLATTERY 299

Berberis vulg. Q (bd) : Fistula of anus. Increase of bile. Sour
 eructations. Great itching of the anus.
Calcarea carb. (tds) : Fistula near the ear or parotid gland.
Calendula off. Q (hs) : Fistula not healing properly may yield to this
 when applied locally. 20 drops to an ounce of
 luke warm water. An effective medicine for
 healing. The lotion may be used externally
 always with other treatment.
Causticum 200 (od) : Fistula and large piles. Dental fistula.
Graphites (bd) : Fistula of anus. Discharge, glutinous and fetid.
Myristica seb. (tds) : Fistula of anus. Action similar to Silicea and
 Hepar sulphuris, but it acts more powerfully
 than these two remedies.
Nitricum acidum 200 (tds) : There are one or two openings-internal or
 external. Soreness and burning pain in the
 lower bowel. Constant oozing of thin, green
 fetid matter from the fistula. It is the remedy
 of first importance.
Paeonia off. (tds) : Fistula ani. Hemorrhoids, fissures and
 ulceration of the anus covered with crusts.
 Burning, biting and itching in anus.
Silicea 1000 (tds) : Abscess fistula. It maybe accompanied with
Only for a day piles. Give three doses in one day, cures in 1-3 weeks. Give Tuberculinum 1000 after cure.
Sulphur (hs) : Blind fistula with cutting pains.

 FLATTERY
Palladium met. (tds) : Ladies of mild temperament with weeping
 mood, who love to be appreciated for all of
 their actions and reasoning. Likes to be told
 that they are beautiful or their dress is
 attractive. Like flattery. Brownish-yellow
 spots on the skin due to sun rays or anemia.
300 FLATULENCE

 FLATULENCE
 (GAS OR WIND TROUBLE)

Agaricus mus. (tds) : Profuse fetid flatus. Gurgling in the abdomen.
 Flatulent distension of the stomach.
Alfalfa Q (bd) : Flatulence with distention of the abdomen.
 Shifting flatulent pain in the abdomen several
 hours after meals.
Aloe soc. (tds) : Copious, offensive flatus during passing of
 stools.
Argentum nit. (tds) : Flatulence with painful swelling of the
 stomach. Abdomen swollen with gas.
 Explosive belching.
Asafoetida 3x (tds) : Pressure of wind is always upwards, never
 downwards. Belching is loud.
Carbo veg. (tds) : Wind bloats in upper part of abdomen.
 Eructation of wind by mouth with noise like
 hiccough relieved by belching or passing wind.
 Pain in stomach on account of gas. Flatulent
 colic - pain extends to the chest.
China off. (tds) : Wind bloats the whole abdomen. Patient says
 that everything eaten turns to gas. Passing of
 wind does not give relief.
Colchicum autum. 200 (bd) : In dyspepsia when there is burning or a
 sensation of coldness in the stomach; much gas
 in the stomach, abdomen or both. The smell
 of cooking food causes nausea. Distention of
 abdomen with gas.
Fucus ves. Q (bd) : Flatulence in fat persons. Digestion is furthered
 and flatulence diminished by the use of this
 remedy.
Graphites (bd) : Very fetid gas preceded by colic.
Kalium carb. (tds) : Abdomen distended with wind immediately
 after eating. Excessive flatulence. Everything
 he eats or drinks appears to be converted into
 gas, specially in aged and broken down
 patients.
 FLATULENCE 301

Lycopodium 200 (od) : Immediately after a light meal, abdomen is
 bloated with gas. Sense of fermentation in
 abdomen. Liver trouble. Wind is in lower parts
 of the abdomen. Passing of wind relieves.
Lycopodium (tds), : Gas is emitted through the vagina.
Lac can. (tds)
Magnesium phos. 6x (qid) : Bloating of abdomen with hot wind. Must
 loosen clothing, walk about constantly passing
 flatus.
Myrica c. (tds) : Constant discharge of flatus when walking.
 Urging to stool with no results, then passing
 of a great amount of flatus.
Nux mosch. (tds) : Dyspepsia. Everything eaten turns into gas
 and fills the stomach and abdomen to cause
 pressure on all the organs in the abdomen.
Nux vomica (tds) : Flatus is due to indigestion and there is often
 pain in the stomach during its passage.
Psorinum (od) : Flatus smells like rotten eggs.
Raphanus (tds) : Wind formation around the navel. No emission
 for a long time.

Rhus g. 3x (tds) : It disinfects the bowels, and flatus and stools
 become free from odor.
Sulphur (od) : Flatus smells like rotten eggs or sewage gas.
Thuja occ. 200 (od) : Flatus in children. Abdomen distended. Loud
 rumbling in abdomen. Passing of wind does
 not give relief.
Note: Most gas is caused by swallowing air or by the normal breakdown of
 undigested foods, like milk sugar, beans, cabbage, etc The smell
 comes from the bacteria in the colon that releases a small amount of
 Sulphur.
302 FLESH EATING DISEASE —FOOD—FOOD POISONING

 FLESH EATING DISEASE
 (NECROTIZING MYOSITIS)

 It is caused by the bacteria which consume flesh, often leading to amputa-tion or death. When the condition spreads into the muscle tissue, it is called
necrotizing myositis. The incubation period of this disease is believed to be
three weeks. It can be transmitted through body secretions exchanged during
close contact, such as kissing. It is an infection in the tissues below the skin
and is caused by Streptococcus bacteria group A. There is no homeopathic
remedy for the treatment of this disease which generally results in death occuring
within 12 to 24 hours.

 FOOD
 (SEE ALSO ‘ALLERGIES’)

Aethusa cyn. (tds) : Nausea at the sight of food.
Arsenicum alb. (tds) : Cannot bear the sight or smell of food. Allergic
 to preserved and cold foods and over-ripe
 fruits.
Bryonia alba (tds) : Allergic to cabbage, vegetables, salad and
 chicken.
Colchicum autum. (tds) : The smell of food,especially fish causes
 nausea, even fainting.
Fragaria vesca (tds) : Strawberry causes urticaria.
Sulphur (od) : Allergic to eggs.
Thuja occ. (bd) : Onions do not agree.

 FOOD POISONING
Arsenicum alb. (qid) : Bad effects of eating decayed vegetables and
 over-ripe fruits.
Carbo veg. (qid) : Vomiting, nausea and diarrhea due to eating
 of decayed meat.
 FOREIGN BODIES—FRACTURES 303

 FOREIGN BODIES
Aconitum nap. (tds) : Profuse watering of the eyes after removal of
 sand or other foreign bodies from them.
Anagallis (tds) : Favors expulsion of splinters, etc.
Ledum pal. 10M (hs) : This remedy relieves the pain from getting a
 foreign body under the finger nail almost
 instantly.It expels iron nails,etc.
Silicea (bd) : Promotes expulsion of foreign bodies from the
 tissues like-fish bones, needles, bone splinters,
 etc.

 FRACTURES
 After the orthopedist has done his job, the following medicines will speed
up the cure:
 Bones
 Fat embolism may occur fracture of
 long bones due to entry of fat from
 the narrow cavity into the torn ends
 of veins.

 By sharp bone Penetrating
 ends injury from
 outside

Pathological fracture Mixture of tumor and hematoma-A common condition is a healing inhibited.
secondary tumour growing in
and destroying the bone.

 Very easily fractured

 Factors influencing healing of fractures

 There may be interposition
 of soft tissue, e.g. muscle

 Callus formation

 In extreme cases, a rudimentary Small callus, good
 joint (pseudoarthrosis may bone formation.
 form.

Arnica mont. 1000 (qid) : Give four doses for one day only. It will remove
For one day only bruises and pains.
Calcarea phos. 6x (qid) : Give four doses daily. It will help to unite the
 bones quickly.
Rhus tox. (tds), : These two remedies should be given in alter-Bryonia alba (tds) ation every two hours to remove pain, if any.
Rhus tox. (tds), : After the plaster has been removed by the
Ruta (tds) surgeon, stiffness usually remains, sometimes
 for months. These medicines used alternatively
 with a gap of two hours, will remove the
 stiffness in a few days.
Ruta Q, : From the second day, take 15-20 drops of the
Symphytum off. Q (qid) mixture of the two, four times daily for 7 days.
 Sympytum off. Q works as a glue for joining
 bones.
Sticta pulm. 200 (hs) : If the patient cannot sleep, due to pain of
Repeat if necessary after fracture, give one dose and if fails to induce
1 hour, one dose only sleep, repeat another dose after an hour. The
 patient will go to sleep.
 FRECKLES 305

Wiesbaden (tds) : Stiffness remaining after joining of bones of
 old fractures is benefited by its use.

 FRECKLES
 (LENTIGO)

 Freckles are yellowish or brownish pigmentations on the exposed parts of
the skin, especially in persons of light complexion. The pigmentation increases
in number on exposure to the sun.
Badiaga (tds) : Freckles on the skin anywhere.
Caulophyllum (tds) : Discoloration of the skin of the face in women
 with menstrual and uterine disorders.
Cimicifuga (tds) : Facial blemishes in young women.
Kalium carb. (tds) : Discoloration of the skin of the face specially
 after child birth or loss of vital fluids.
Lycopodium (tds) : Freckles worse on left side of the face and nose.
Natrium carb. (tds) : Freckles. Yellow spots on the face. Blue ring
 around the eyes.
Natrium hyposulph. Q (bd) : Use locally and internally for removal of
 yellow and brown spots.
Sepia 10M (hs) : Yellow blotches on the face. Yellow about the
 mouth. Saddle-like brownish distribution on
 the nose and cheeks. Circumscribed discolored
 skin spots in young women.
Thuja occ. (bd) : Dry skin. Circumscribed brown spots on the
 face and elsewhere on the skin.
Vanadium 6 (tds) : Black freckles over head and nose - with
 hypotension and weight loss.
NOTE: When the discoloration patches are dark or blackish in color, often
 found in dark skinned women, during pregnancy or menopause, the
 condition of the skin is called “Melasma” or in laymans language,
 “Tan”. Melasma does not lead to melanoma which is an aggressive
 type of cancer.
306 FRIGIDITY

 FRIGIDITY
 (IMPOTENCY IN FEMALES)

 This is an inability of the female to experience sexual pleasure and
satisfaction. It can occur with certain diseases such as diabetes, pelvic disorders
under an active thyroid, hypertension, etc. It can occur from over-drugging
specially with tranquilizers, etc. A poor technique of the male to arouse
stimulation in the female partner also leads to it.
Agnus castus (tds) : Abhorrence of intercourse. Mental depression.
 Generalized itching especially of the eyes.
Berberis vulg. (tds) : Painful intercourse with vaginal burning and
 soreness in listless and apathetic women.
Damiana Q (bd) : Sexual weakness from nervous prostration and
 hence frigidity. It is an important remedy for
 its removal.
Ginseng Q (tds), : 30 drops a dose in half a cup of water of the
Yohimbinum Q (tds) mixture of these two remedies in equal parts,
 taken three times a day works as a proactive
 stimulant of sexual desire both for young men
 and women.
Graphites (od) : Aversion to intercourse with a pale, thin,
 profuse vaginal discharge, in fat, chilly and
 timid women.
Ignatia amara (tds) : Total frigidity with great changes in moods.
 Sensitive and easily excited.
Lycopodium (tds) : A dry vaginal wall makes intercourse painful.
Murex purp. (tds) : It produces violent sexual desire and the desire
 is easily aroused by touch of parts or by even
 scratching the arm.
Onosmodium (tds) : Complete absence of sexual desire. The breasts
 ache, the nipples itch. The patient often suffers
 from migraine.
Sepia (tds) : Vagina painful during intercourse. Prolapse of
 the uterus. The woman is sad and indifferent
 to the family.
 FRIGIDITY—FROSTBITE—FUNGAL DISEASES 307

NOTE 1: Frigidity is a female sexual dysfunction camparable to impotency
 in males. Some females are unable to achieve orgasm and this
 leads to nervous disorders and vices. Blood flow to the clitoris is
 important for a woman for arousal and sexual satisfaction as the
 blood flow to the penis in a man. There is a system called ‘eros’ to
 achieve it. A soft suction pump is placed on the clitoris. There is a
 tube attached to it which is operated by a hand held battery. A few
 minutes of switching on the device makes the clitoris engorged.
 The device is then turned off and removed. Women becomes fully
 aroused and achieve orgasm in a short time on sexual intercourse.
NOTE 2: An excellent mixture as a general tonic and for cure of frigidity in
 females is Avena sativa Q + Damiana Q + Siberian ginseng Q in
 equal parts. 15 drops of this mixture in a little water three times a
 day for 2 months gives excellent results.

 FROSTBITE
 (SEE ‘CHILBLAINS’)

 Local tissue destruction resulting from exposure to extreme cold is known
as frostbite.

 FUNGAL DISEASES

Alumen (tds) : Whitish ulceration patches on the membrane
 of the vagina.
Arsenicum alb. (tds) : Fungoid growth burns and itches specially at
 night - with relief by a warm water wash.
 Eruptions on palms like dry bran.
Borax (tds) : Whitish ulceration on the mucous membrane
 of the mouth and on the hard palate specially
 in young children. Lesions are sometimes
 formed beneath the tongue.
Calcarea carb. (tds) : Fungus infection of the vagina with itching and
 milky discharge, and it is worse before menses.
Echinacea Q (tds) : It is antifungus and antibiotic.
308 FUNGAL DISEASES—GALL BLADDER

Lachesis (bd) : Blackish-blue fungus on the ear drum.
Lycopodium (tds) : Fungus growth specially on palms of hands.
 Skin becomes dry, shrunken and fissured with
 violent itching.
Mancinella (tds) : Dermatitis. Oozing of a sticky substance from
 the crusts. Fungoid growths from heavy brown
 crusts, scales and fissures.
Phosphorus (bd) : Fungoid growths with blood-like crusts and
 fissures which bleed easily.
Sepia (tds) : Fungus infection of the vagina with a very
 offensive discharge; pain under the nails due
 to fungus growth.
Silicea : Whitish fungus growths.
Thuja occ. 200 (od) : Fungus growth on any part of the body.
 Treatment should be started with 200C potency
 of this remedy and then any other indicated
 remedy may be given. It is specially useful for
 bleeding fungus growths.
NOTE : Yeast is an unicellular fungi and is treated with the above remedies.
 Fungus growths and reputations like dry bran with itching.

 GALL BLADDER
Arsenicum sulph. rub. : Gall stone colic with fever.
200 (bd)
Baptisia (tds) : Soreness over the region of the gall bladder
 with diarrhea. Stools very offensive.
Belladonna 200 (tds) : It is very valuable in gall stone colic. It can be
 repeated often till the colic disappears.
Berberis vulg. Q (tds) : Helps removal of gall stones and pain due to
 them.
Calcarea carb. (tds) : Helps to remove colic due to gall or kidney
 stones. Should be repeated every 30 minutes.
 GALL BLADDER 309

 Inflamed

 Exudate Enlarged:
 on swelling
 serous of mucosa
 surface
 Reddish
 color

 Mixture of bile,
 blood and pus

 Thickened mucosal folds

 Wall thickened and firm
 Gall stones Occasionally the wall may,
 be calcified

Calculus biliari 12x (tds) : Breaks gall stones to form a powder and
 facilitates their painless expulsion.
Carduus mar. Q (tds) : Swelling of the gall bladder with tenderness
 and pain. Prevents further formation of gall
 stones.
Chelidonium 200 (bd) : Gall stone colic and jaundice due to the
 obstruction of gall bladder by gall stones.
 Helps expulsion of gall stones and reduces
 pain on this account.
China off. 200 (bd) : It prevents formation of gall stones and reduces
 pain, if occurring at night.
Chionanthus Q (tds) : A prominent remedy for prevention of
 formation of the gall stones. Helps expulsion
 of gall stones if already formed.
310 GALL BLADDER—GANGRENE

Cholesterinum 3x (tds) : It is a very near specific remedy for removing
 gall stone colic. Relieves at once.
Fel tauri 2x or 3x (tds) : Increases duodenal secretion, emulsifies fats
 and increases the action of the intestines.
 Liquefies bile, removes obstruction of the gall
 ducts and helps expulsion of biliary calculi.
Hydrastis (tds) : Gall stones with dragging in the right groin
 and right testicle. Jaundice and constipation.
Mercurius iod. (tds) : A lump on the gall bladder with enlargement
 of the liver. Urine smells like mustard oil. Great
 pain.
Mercurius sulph. (tds) : A lump on the gall bladder with inflammation
 of the liver. Stools are black.
NOTE : Gall stones are usually made up of cholestrol, bilirubin and protein.

 GANGRENE
 Death of a tissue due to deficient blood supply or absence of blood supply.
For healing, it is necessary that the dead matter is removed.
Acidum mur. (tds) : Gangrene of the cheek. Frequent, foul
 eructations. Vomitus foul and dirty.

 Necrotic muscle

 Gas bubbles
 GANGRENE—GASTRIC TROUBLES 311

Acidum sulph. (tds) : Blue and purple surroundings of the gangrene.
 Bleeding under the skin. Gangrene after an
 operation or after mechanical injuries.
Arsenicum alb. (tds) : Diabetic gangrene. Burning, fetid smell from
 the wound. Dry, specially of the uterus and
 lungs, better warmth.
Baptisia (tds) : Gangrene of the cheek. Symptoms like typhoid.
Carbo veg. (tds) : Carbuncles and boils become gangrenous, wet,
 purple and icy cold.
Crotalus hor. (tds) : Wet gangrene; emits a foul smell and oozes
 freely.
Echinacea Q (2 hourly) : Gangrene, emitting a foul smell. Use 10 drops
 in an ounce of luke warm water locally as a
 cleaning and antiseptic wash and 5 drops in a
 little water every two hours, internally.
Kreosotum (tds) : Specially of lungs and uterus, particularly in
 old age. Foul smell. Better warmth.
Lachesis 200 (bd) : Bluish-purple surroundings of the gangrene.
 Gangrene produced on account of injuries on
 septic wounds.
Secale cor. (tds) : Dry gangrene of toes . Dusky blue tinge. Skin
 feels cold to touch yet covering is not tolerated.
Tarentula cub. (tds) : Painful and inflamed abscess with tendency
 to gangrene.

 GASTRIC TROUBLES
Abies nig. (tds) : A useful remedy for gastric ailments specially
 of the aged. Constipation. Pain in the stomach
 after eating.Sensation of a hard boiled egg at
 the end of the stomach. Sensation as if food is
 lodged at the pit of the stomach.
Aconitum nap. (tds) : This remedy is very useful in acute gastritis.
 Burning from stomach to esophagus. Intense
 thirst. Drinks and vomits.
312 GASTRIC TROUBLES

Anacardium, : Use any of these remedies when eating relieves
Chelidonium, all discomfort temporarily.
Petroleum
Antimonium crud. (tds) : Gastric troubles caused by hyper loading of
 the stomach. Persistent nausea and occasional
 vomiting. Eructations tasting of the ingesta.
 Heartburn. After nursing,child vomits the milk
 in curds and thereafter refuses to be nursed.
 Aversion to pastry and fatty foods. Thickly
 coated white tongue will guide to the use of
 this remedy.
Argentum nit. (tds) : Chronic duodenal ulcers with intolerable
 burning and pain in the stomach and duodenal
 region. Patients are usually thin and worried.
Arsenicum alb. (tds) : For pains and cure of the ulcer when it is in
 the lower orifice of the stomach. Retching and
 vomiting after eating and drinking. Burning
 pain in the stomach. Long lasting eructations.
 Vomiting of blood mixed with green or dark
 brown mucus.
Atropinum (tds) : It is a very good remedy to subside the frightful
 pain of gastric ulcer.
Bismuthum (tds) : A remedy for pure gastralgia.
Calcarea carb. : Nausea with sour water in the mouth.
Graphites 6 (tds) : Persistent scarring of duodenal ulcers, this
 remedy will cure within 15 days.
Hydrastis Q (bd) : In all the forms of stomatitis of children and
 ulceration of the stomach. Dose-5 drops in
 water, thrice a day.
Kreosotum (tds) : Nothing equals this remedy for the vomiting
 in gastric carcinoma.
Nux vomica (tds) : Gastric oppression after a good and heavy meal
 and alcoholic drinks. Sensation of nausea or
 diarrhea. Much flatus. Gastric catarrh.
Ornithogalum (tds) : Gastric induration, ulcer of stomach.
 Hemorrhage from stomach.
 GIARDIASIS—GIDDINESS—GLAUCOMA 313

Phosphorus (bd) : Excessive flatus. In gastric troubles, frequent
 palpitation, intermittent pulse with much
 despondency and with great thirst.
Pulsatilla nig. (tds) : Heartburn is calmed down by its use.
Robinia (tds) : Gastric ulcers on account of hyperacidity.
Sulphur (od) : It may cure 50% of chronic gastric ulcers. Rest
 may be cured with Carbo veg.

 GIARDIASIS
 It has symptoms similar to amoebiasis and stools under microscopic
examination show the presence of giardia. Treatment is similar as in amoebiasis.

 GIDDINESS
 (SEE ALSO ‘VERTIGO’)

Ferrum phos. 6x (qid) : Giddiness on seeing flowing water.
Kalium phos. 6x (qid) : Giddiness from exhaustion and nervous
 weakness.
Lachesis (tds) : Giddiness when closing eyes.
Nux vomica (tds) : Giddiness while eating.

 GLAUCOMA
 (HARDENING OF THE EYEBALL)

Colocynthis (tds) : Pain in the eyeballs before glaucoma has set
 in. Sensation as if eyeballs would fall out.
 When the pain travels to the head and is better
 by pressure. It acts as a good palliative.
Comocladia den. (tds) : Eyes feel large and protruded specially at night.
 Feels as if pressed outward. Sense of fullness.
 Eyeballs seem to be large.
314 GLAUCOMA—GLEET—GOITRE

Conium mac. (tds) : Sensation of pressure in the eyes when
 reading, writing or doing any fine work.
Eserinum 6x (tds) : Dilatation of pupils with hardening of the
 eyeballs.
Gelsemium (tds) : Dilatation of pupils, disturbed accomodation,
 pain in eyes, with or without lachrymation.
Phosphorus (bd) : Thrombosis of retinal vessels and degenerative
 changes in retinal cells.
Spigelia (tds) : Pains sharp and stabbing through the eye and
 head, worse on motion and at night.
NOTE 1: This disease is better treated by an ophthalmologist because surgery
 is often needed in such cases.
NOTE 2: According to an estimate, glaucoma is the leading cause of blindness
 affecting 67 million people around the globe. Elderly, diabetics and
 those with hypertension are at the greatest risk of suffering from
 this disease.

 GLEET
 (THIN, MUCOID DISCHARGE
 FROM THE URETHRA)

Kalium iod. (tds) : Emission of thin, watery, mucus from the
 urethra in chronic gonorrhea.
Sepia (tds) : Emission of thick yellowish-green mucoid
 discharge from urethra of males or females.
 Micturition is slow and takes a long time to
 complete.

 GOITRE
(ENLARGEMENT OF THE THYROID GLAND)
 (SEE ALSO ‘THYROID GLAND’)

 Commence with Spongia, followed by Sulphur and later Iodium. In severe
cases, Bromium followed by Calcarea carb., Lycopodium and Causticum
in the same order will cure most cases of goitre.
 GOITRE 315

 Gland is diffusely
 enlarge; pale pink
 in color

Alnus 3c (tds) : Goitre with indigestion due to imperfect
 secretion of gastric juices.
Belladonna (tds) : Exophthalmic goitre. Marked protusion of
 eyeballs, increased heart action, enlargement
 of the thyroid gland, weight loss and
 nervousness.
Bromium CM (hs) : If Iodium fails, this remedy maybe needed
Repeat after a month for six months, one dose a month. Hard goitre.
Calcarea carb. 200 (bd) : A simple goitre with the symptoms of this
 remedy and fatness. Perspiration on the head
 and neck. Two doses daily.
Calcarea fluor. 200 (bd) : For painful, hard goitre with horny growths.
Calcarea iod. 3x (tds) : Goitre about the time of puberty.
Ephedra (bd) : Exophthalmic goitre. Eyes feel pushed out with
 increased palpitations of the heart or
 hypertention. It should not be used in too low
 or too high potencies which can produce
 adverse affects.
Fucus ves. Q (tds) : It is a remedy for non-toxic goitre and
 exopthalmic goitre. Obstinate constipation and
 obesity. 20 drop doses, thrice daily.
Hydrastis Q (od) : Goitre at puberty and pregnancy.
Iodium CM (hs) : Patient is always hungry. Eats well and yet
For 4 days emaciates. Enlargement of the thyroid gland.
 Always feels better by eating. When these
316 GOITRE—GONORRHEA

 symptoms are present with goitre, a dose every
 night for four days after full moon is waning
 will clear the symptoms with three-four
 monthly treatments. Iodine is necessary for
 normal functioning and normal growth and
 development of the brain and body. Deficiency
 of iodine in the body, can produce goitre and
 more commonly, reduction of mental capacity
 in new borns.
Lapis albus (tds) : Soft goitre at a pre-ulcerative stage of
 carcinoma.
Lycopodium 1M (hs) : Abnormal protrusion of eyeballs from the
 orbits. Diarrhea after meals.Menses irregular
 and painful.A small tumor-like swelling on the
 right side of upper neck.
Natrium mur. 200 (od) : Goitre with great emaciation, palpitation and
 sleeplessness. It is very useful to finish and
 fix a cure.
Spongia (tds) : Thyroid gland is swollen. Throat is dry and
 burning.
Thyreoidinum 3x (qid) : When there is a great craving of sugar and
 tendency to obesity in this disease. This remedy
 maybe given every two hours for a long time.
Thuja occ. 200 (hs) : It is indicated when the veins are very promi-Repeat every 5th day nent on the goitre. A dose every fifth day.
NOTE : Goitre is more prevalent in fresh water and lake countries and less so
 on the sea coast, due to the lack of iodine in fresh water. Iodine and
 iodized salts are used as remedies and preventives.

 GONORRHEA
Agnus castus (tds) : History of repeated gonorrhea. Suicidal
 thoughts due to the disease.
Argentum nit. (tds) : Burning in the urethra. Frequent desire to pass
 urine. Sensation as if a few drops remained
 behind after urination.
 GONORRHEA—GOUT 317

Copaiva off. (tds) : Burning pressure. Painful micturition by drops.
 Retention of urine. Urine has a bad smell.
 Discharge is of greenish turbid color with a
 pungent odor. Testicles swollen. In females,
 violent itching of vulva with bloody discharge.
Kreosotum (tds) : Discharge is very fetid. Gonorrhea of females
 with itching of the vaginal canal and vulva.
Mercurius cor. (tds) : It is always indicated in one stage or the other.
 The stream of urine is thin and feeble, so it
 takes a longer time to finish urination.
 Discharge is yellowish-green, both in men and
 women.
Natrium sulph. (tds) : Inflammation of the prepuce. Itching of the
 glans and penis. Discharge yellowish and
 greenish.
Silicea 200 (bd) : The discharge of gonorrhea from the urethra
 is thick, foul and bloody. Two doses maybe
 given daily, morning and evening.
Thuja occ. 200 (hs) : Treatment should be started with this remedy
Repeat after a week in recent or long standing cases. No medicine
 should be given on the day when this remedy
 is given. Discharge is thin and greenish. Painful
 urination.

 GOUT
 (RHEUMATISM)

Acidum fluor. (tds) : It works in any constitution when heat
 aggravates the pain and the patient has the
 ability to withstand any amount of cold.
Actaea spic. 3x (tds) : Rheumatism of small joints of the fingers and
 wrists.
Ammonium phos. (tds) : Chronic gout with nodosities in finger joints
 and back of hands. Rheumatic pain in the
 shoulder joints.
Antimonium crud. (tds) : Rheumatic pain in fingers. Thick white coated
318 GOUT

 tongue is a sure indiation for its use. Finger
 joints may be swollen.
Arnica mont. (tds) : Rheumatic or other pains due to injury such as
 a fall or a severe wrench. The pain is burning
 and the part is sore to touch. The patient desires
 to be alone and is better by gentle movement
 for a short moment and is worse by prolonged
 movement, heat, rest and light pressure.
Arsenicum alb. (tds) : Rheumatic pain in the forearm worse during
 the night. Pains are burning and are relieved
 by warmth.
Aurum mur. (tds) : Old cases of rheumatism and gout pains.
 Tearing, drawing, pressing and stitching pains,
 better by heat and worse by cold.
Azadirachta (tds) : Rheumatic pains in sternum, ribs, shoulders
 and extremities.
Benzoicum acidum (tds) : Rheumatic and gouty pains in patients suffering
 from urinary troubles. Urine contains several
 deposits, is of high color and smells like the
 urine of a horse. Pain often changes position.
 In such conditions, it relieves the pain.
Berberis vulg. (tds) : Rheumatic pain in shoulders, arms, hands,
 fingers, legs and feet. Neuralgia under finger
 nails with swelling of finger joints. Pain in
 heels as if standing on a nail. Pain in the balls
 of heels on standing.
Bryonia alba 200 (bd) : The pains are gouty, aggravated on motion and
 are better by rest, pressure and warmth. The
 joints are red,hot and swollen.
Calcarea carb. (tds) : Rheumatic pains are sharp and stitching as if
 wrenched, after exposure to wet. Rheumatism
 on account of defective bony growths.
 Weakness of the extremities and swelling of
 joints specially knee pains on account of
 working in water.
Calcarea carb. (tds), : Deposit of chalk stones in the finger joints,
Ledum pal. (tds), wrists and toes.
Lycopodium (tds)
 GOUT 319

Calcarea phos. (tds) : Rheumatism worse during winter and better in
 summer. Stiffness and pain with a cold and
 numb feeling. Buttocks, back and limbs go to
 sleep.
Camphora 200 (bd) : Rheumatic affections in cold climate.
Carbonium sulph. (tds) : Chronic rheumatism and gout. Flying pains
 return regularly for a long time. Lightening-like pains with cramps.
Cascara sag. (tds) : It’s use proves useful in rheumatism of muscles
 and joints when there is obstinate constipation
 also.
Caulophyllum (tds) : Rheumatic pains in small joints like fingers,
 toes, ankles, etc. Aching in wrists. Cutting pains
 on closing hands. Erratic pains, changing place
 every few minutes.
Causticum (tds) : Manifests its action mainly in chronic
 rheumatism and arthritis. Deformities of joints.
 Restless at night due to pains. Cracking and
 tension in knees. Stiffness in the hollow of the
 knee. Worse dry cold winds, in clear fine
 weather and cold air. Better in damp and wet
 weather, and warmth specially heat of the bed.
Chamomilla (tds) : Pains are violent and accompanied with
 numbness. Patient is very sensitive to pains,
 often cries on this account and says that he
 would prefer death than pain. Very effective
 for pains with numbness. Ankles give way in
 the afternoon.
Chelidonium (tds) : Rheumatism of the feet and ankles ususally
 accompanied by liver troubles.
China off. (tds) : Chronic gout. Pain in limbs and joints as if
 sprained, worse by slight touch. Joints swollen,
 pain in knees, worse by standing, better sitting.
Chininum sulph. 2x (tds) : Acute anticular rheumatism. Polyarticular
 gout. There is marked periodity in pains and
 swellings.
Cimicifuga (tds) : Pain worse at night, in wet weather.
 Rheumatism of large muscles.
320 GOUT

Colchicum autum. (tds) : It has a specific power of relieving the gouty
 attacks. The parts are red, hot and swollen.
 Tearing pain worse in the evening, at night and
 from touch. Sharp pains down left arm. Gout
 of heel. Shifting rheumatism. Edematous
 swelling of legs and feet.
Colocynthis (tds) : Contraction of muscles. Cramp-like pains in
 the hip. Pain from hip to knee. Pain in the left
 knee joint. The patient lies on the painful side
 as pressure and warmth relieve the pain.
Drosera (tds) : Pain in ankles and feet with stiffness.
Dulcamara (tds) : Symptoms similar to Rhus tox. Acts better
 when days are hot and nights are cold.
 Rheumatic symptoms after skin affections.
 Patients living or working in old and wet
 basements.
Eupatorium perf. (tds) : Distressing pain in the bones of great toe, wrist,
 etc. accompanied with restlessness. Gouty
 soreness and inflammed nodosities of joints
 and headache. Aching in the back, arms and
 legs.
Formica rufa (tds) : Rheumatism comes on with suddenness and
 restlessness. Sweat does not relieve. Relief
 after midnight and from rubbing.
Fragaria vesca 200 (bd) : Prevents the attacks of gout.
Gaultheria oil (bd) : Give 20 drop doses, relieves much of the
 discomfort due to pain of gout, arthritis and
 rheumatism.
Gettisberg aqua 6x (tds) : Sub-acute and chronic rheumatism and sub-acute gouty state. Sensation of rigidity in
 muscles and tendons of joints of hips,
 shoulders, wrists, lower back and neck. Pain
 and rigidity worse moving and relieved by rest
 and when quiet. Urine is high colored with
 sandy sediments.
Ginseng Q (bd) : A useful remedy for treatment of rheumatium,
 lumbago and sciatica. Joints become stiff and
 contracted, and there is an increase in the
 amount of urine excreted.
 GOUT 321

Gnaphalium 200 (od) : Chronic rheumatism, backache and pain in the
 neck. Sciatica. Numbness alternates with pain.
Guaiacum off. Q (tds) : Rheumatic pains in hands, arms and shoulders.
 Sciatica and lumbago. Gouty pains tearing and
 lacinating. Worse from motion, heat, cold wet
 weather, touch, pressure, 6 PM to 4 AM. Better
 by external pressure. Nodosities of joints and
 contraction of muscles.
Indigo tinc. (tds) : Pain from the middle of thigh to the knee. Knee
 joint has a boring pain which is relieved by
 walking and is worse after every meal.
Kalium brom. (tds) : Chronic gout of nodular form. Hands become
 hard. Fingers and muscles jerk and twitch.
Kalium carb. (tds) : Pain in knees; it may extend from hip to
 knee.Pain in the limbs and in arms from
 shoulders to wrist. Worse by pressure but better
 by moving about and warmth. Pains are sharp
 and cutting.
Kalium iod. (tds) : Old gouty patients. Must keep in constant
 motion because it gives relief.
Kalmia lat. (tds) : Rheumatic pains travel from upwards to
 downwards with numbness. Rheumatic pains
 of scapula and shoulder muscles, specially
 right side.
Ledum pal. (tds) : Pains travel from below upwards. Patient feels
 chilly, yet he does not like to be covered as his
 pains are better by cold. In chronic cases, chalk
 stone oozes from the finger joints. Pain in joints
 especially small ones. Joints are swollen, hot
 and pale. Cracking of joints worse warmth of
 bed.
Lycopersicum escu. (tds) : Dull pain in the lumbar region. Sharp pain in
 right deltoid and breast muscles. Pain in the
 right elbow, wrist, in both hands and legs.
Lycopodium (tds) : Chronic gout with chalky deposits in joints.
 Numbness and drawing and tearing in limbs.
Magnesium carb. (tds) : Tearing in shoulders as if dislocated. Right
322 GOUT

 shoulder painful. The patient is unable to raise
 it. Swelling of the bend of knees.
Medorrhinum 1M (hs) : Rheumatism originated from gonorrhea, worse
Repeat once a week during the day.
Mercurius sol. (tds) : Lacerating pain in joints. Cold, fetid sweat on
 the legs at night. Dropsical swelling of feet and
 legs.
Mimosa p. (tds) : Rheumatism of back and limbs. Knees stiff.
 Swelling of ankles. Legs tremble.
Natrium phos. (tds) : Rheumatic arthritis. Crackling of joints. Pain
 in the wrist and finger joints. Its use in
 alteration with Natrium sulph. is useful for
 pains of small joints.
Natrium sulph. (tds) : Rheumatism of persons living in basements or
 damp houses. They are worse by bathing and
 in rainy weather. Edema of feet. Piercing pains
 between scapulae. Cracking of joints.
Nux vomica (tds) : Cracking in knee joints when walking. Drags
 feet when walking. Sensation of sudden loss
 of power in arms and legs in the morning.
Oxalicum acidum (tds) : Pains through the lower lobe of the left lung
 and pain under the scapula and between the
 shoulder to the lower back.
Propylaminum Q (qid) : Palliates fever and pain in a day or two in acute
 rheumatism. Rheumatic pains change places
 specially in heart lesions. Pain in the wrists
 and ankles worse by slightest motion. Fingers
 cannot hold things - even a needle held in the
 hand appears too heavy. Tingling numbness of
 fingers. 10-15 drops in a glass full of water -
 teaspoonful doses every 2 hours.
Pulsatilla nig. (tds) : Pain in the joints shifts from place to place. It
 is generally due to changes associated with the
 menstrual cycle. The patient has a tendency to
 be emotional and tearful. She desires sympathy
 and consolation. Is worse in the evening and
 night and by lying on the painful side.

GOUT 323

Radium brom. (tds) : It is a very useful remedy in chronic rheumatic
 arthritis. Severe pain in all the limbs and joints,
 knees, ankles, shoulders, arms, hands, fingers,
 toes, calves, hip joints, etc. all have pains which
 are worse at night, open air, touch, cold air
 and movements.
Ranunculus bulb. (tds) : Rheumatic and muscular pains along the lower
 margin of shoulder blade. Pain like pleurodynia
 in chest. Worse in spring.
Rhamnus cal. Q (qid) : A positive remedy for muscular pains and
 rheumatism. 10 drops a dose, four times a day.
 It is indicated when there is constipation also.
Rhododendron ch. (tds) : Pains are wandering, now in this joint and then
 in that joint. Arthritic nodes. Pains are worse
 before thunderstorm and in hot season. Gout
 of toe joints.
Rhus tox. 200 (tds) : Gout worse in damp and rainy weather. Pain
 increases from rising from a sitting position or
 on first motion and becomes better by walking
 for sometime and increases again on taking a
 long walk. Rheumatism due to suppression of
 perspiration. Pain in nape of neck and lions.
 Tearing pain in tendons, ligaments and face.
Ruta (tds) : Pain in the tendons appearing after their injury.
 Pain due to a bruise in the lining of the bones.
 Pain is better by movement and is worse in
 damp, cold weather and during rest.
Sabina (tds) : Arthritic pain in joints. Gout due to urinary
 troubles worse in a heated room and on motion.
Sanguinaria (tds) : Pain in the right shoulder and arm worse from
 the heat of the bed. Pain on raising the arm.
Solanum lyc. (tds) : Dull pain in the lumbar region. Sharp pain in
 the right deltoid and breast muscle. Pain in the
 right elbow, wrist and in both hands and legs.
Stellaria m. Q (bd), : Chronic rheumatic pains.
Aurum mur. nat. 3x (tds),
Carbonium sulph. (tds),
China off. (tds)
324 GOUT—GROIN

Syphilinum 1000 (hs) : Rheumatism of the shoulder joint at the
 intersection of deltoid. Muscles become hard,
 knotty or lumpy and contracted to form knots.
Thyreoidinum (od) : Rheumatic arthritis with tendency to obesity.
 Swelling of legs and other parts of body and
 cramps.
Tongo 3x (tds) : Severe pain in hips joints, femur and knees,
 specially the left.
Tuberculinum 1M (hs) : When the origin is tubercular. Acute
 rheumatism of the bones of joints.
 Inflammation of joints. Worse motion,
 standing, dampness and early in the morning
 after sleep. Better open air.
Urtica urens Q (tds) : Rheumatism associated with urticaria-like
 eruptions or rheumatism alternates with such
 eruptions. Pain in wrists and ankles, worse
 during snow and moist air.
Vanadium 6 (tds) : In absence of definite symptoms, the use of
 this remedy in chronic rheumatism produces
 good results.
NOTE 1: Rheumatoid arthritis occurs when the immune system attacks joints
 causing severe inflammation, pain and stiffness. Other types of
 arthritis occur in elderly people and is caused by wear and tear of
 aging.
NOTE 2: Tennis elbow (epicondylitis) as the name applies is a pain localized at
 the level of the elbow. It affects the tendon called epicondylics which
 is attached to the elbow. It affects players of tennis, badminton or
 any game where the elbow is overused. Treatment is according to
 the symptoms.

 GROIN
 (INGUINAL REGION)

Bellis per. (tds) : Sore and bruised feeling in the pelvic region.
 Bad effects of injuries to the pelvic organs and
 deeper tissues.
Berberis vulg. (tds) : Stitching pain in the groins with urinary
 GROIN—GUILT—GUMS 325

 troubles or menstrual complaints - worse
 motion and standing.
Calcarea carb. 200 (od) : When Rhus tox. ceases to work and the pain is
 worse in cold damp weather and better by
 movements.
Calcarea phos. (tds) : Soreness in the joint, in bones of sacrum and
 illium, as if broken. Symptoms are worse with
 any change in weather.
Dulcamara (tds) : Pain in the groins.
Kalium nit. (tds) : Burning pain in the groins during menstruation
 only, worse while bending. Menses black,
 preceded with severe backache.
Mercurius iod. fl. 2x (tds) : Swollen inguinal glands, large and hard.
Natrium mur. (tds) : Burning pain in the groins during menstruation.
Podophyllum (tds) : Pain in the right inguinal region shoots from
 the inner thighs to knees, worse early morning.
Rhus tox. (tds) : Tearing pain in the groins due to exposure to
 damp, wet winds or due to lifting of heavy
 weights. Swelling of inguinal glands.

 GUILT
 (SEE ‘DEPRESSION’)

Thuja occ. (tds), : Hidden feeling of guilt and depression thereof.
Arsenicum alb. (tds),
Natrium sulph. (tds),
Staphysagria (tds)

 GUMS

GINGIVITIS (INFLAMMED GUMS)

Ammonium carb. (tds) : Gums recede from the teeth and the teeth
 become loose.
326 GUMS

Argentum nit. (tds) : Tenderness and bleeding from the gums.
 Inflammation of the gums.
Carbo veg. (tds) : Teeth separate from gums. Pain from hot or
 cold drinks and their application.
Causticum (tds) : Gums bleed easily.
Hypericum 3x (tds) : Gum pains from extraction of teeth. Soothes
 gum pain.
Kreosotum (tds) : Spongy and bleeding gums.
Magnesium carb. (tds) : Bloody saliva with swelling of gums but teeth
 are intact.
Mercurius sol. (tds) : Sensative to hot or cold. Gums swollen.
 Offensive breath and excessive saliva in the
 mouth. Fresh air and fasting relieves. Bleeding.
Natrium mur. (tds) : Gums bleed with a taste of pus in the mouth
 and are sensitive to both hot and cold. There
 may be ulcers on the gums and in the mouth.
Podophyllum (tds) : Pressing of the gums together in children, with
 diarrhea.
GUM BOIL

Aconitum nap. (tds) : Early stage of gum boil with throbbing pain.
Belladonna (qid) : If three hourly four doses of Aconitum do not
 relieve the pain, give this remedy.
 Inflammatory redness and swelling of the
 gums. It will often arrest an incipient gum boil.
Borax 3x (tds) : Painful gum boils.
Calcarea fluor. 6x (tds) : Its use cures the gum boils when there is a hard
 swelling on the jaw.
Carbo animalis (tds) : Bleeding; painful and burning gum boils.

Hekla lava 3x (tds) : For painful gum boils and abscess of gums.

Mercurius sol. (tds) : Bright redness of the gum boil. Excessive fetid
 saliva. Inflammation of the gums.
Rhus g. Q : It can be applied locally to soft, spongy gums
Locally to give relief.
Silicea (tds) : Gum boils with pus.
 HAIR 327

 HAIR

HAIR FALL

Acidum fluor. (tds) : Falling of hair after typhoid fever.
Acidum phos. (tds) : Falling of hair after an exhausting disease.
 Hairfall from head, eyebrows, eyelashes, etc.
Calcarea phos. (tds) : Falling of hair in bunches on combing is cured
 by the remedy.
Ferrum phos. (tds) : Hairfall from the head due to anemia.
Kalium carb. (tds) : For falling of hair due to dryness of the scalp
 and dandruff.
Natrium mur. (tds) : Falling of hair after child birth. Hair come out
 in excess while combing.
Nitricum acidum (tds) : Falling of pubic hair due to syphilis or
 gonorrhea.
Sabal ser. (tds) : It is beneficial in the treatment of thinning hair.
Selenium met. (tds) : Useful for falling of pubic hair - if needed at
 all.
Sepia (tds), : Use of either remedy stops falling of hair
Carbo veg. (tds) during pregnancy, after child birth and during
 nursing of a child.
Sulphur (bd), : These remedies are also useful for the falling
Lycopodium (tds) of hair in nursing mothers. Lycopodium is also
 useful for greying hair at a young age.
Sphingurus mar. (tds) : Falling out of hair from the beard.
Thallium (tds) : Falling of hair after diseases. Alopecia with
 much perspiration on the head. Loss of hair as
 an after-effect of bursting of an atom bomb.
Thuja occ. (tds) : Use this remedy when the hair grow slowly
 and split after growing. Use it as a general
 remedy for falling of hair.
Thymus serpyllum Q : Helps in the regrowth of hair.
Vinca minor (tds) : Use of this remedy cures matting of hair
 together after a head wash.
328 HAIR—HAIR - PREMATURE GREYING—HAIR - UNWANTED

Wiesbaden 200 (od) : By the use of this remedy, the hair will grow
 more rapidly than usual and become darker.
 New hair take the place of the fallen hair
 rapidly.

 HAIR - PREMATURE GREYING
 Hair contains a black-brown pigment and a yellow-red pigment. The amount
and distribution of the pigments determine the hair color. When the secretion
of the pigment is lessened, the shaft of the hair whitens. Normally hair gradually
greys then whitens as people grow older and the quantity and distribution of
the pigment decreases. This is determined by heredity. Stress or illness may
also affect the formation of pigment. How to stop it is discussed below:
Acidum phos. 1c (hs) : Hair thin out and turn grey early and fall out.
Repeat every 15 days
Lycopodium (tds) : It is specific for premature greying of hair.
Natrium mur. (tds), : Use of either of these remedies when indica-Phosphorus (tds) ted or otherwise also stop further premature
 greying of hair after diseases.
Pilocarpus 1000 (hs) : If the hair are greying prematurely due to dry-Repeat after 15 days ness of the scalp, the use of this remedy stops
 it by stimulating natural secretion of the scalp.
Thyreoidinum 3x (tds) : It stops premature greying of hair due to
 thyroid diseases. It also helps to restore the
 natural color of hair not turned completely
 grey.

 HAIR - UNWANTED

FACIAL HAIR

Oleum jec. 3x (tds) : Give this remedy 3 times a day after the use of
 Thuja occ. 1M.
 HAIR - UNWANTED 329

Thuja occ. 1M (hs) : Start the treatment with this. One dose a day
Repeat after a month and no medicine for 24 hours. Repeat after a
 month.
Waxing : The medication takes a long time to be
 effective. Along with it, the method of waxing
 can be adopted. Take liquid wax from a drug
 store. Spread a light layer of it on the skin and
 cut a strong cloth equal to the size of the space
 between the nose and upper lip where there is
 unwanted growth of hair in a woman. Apply it
 firmly on the space. After about 2 minutes take
 off the cloth steadily but firmly. All the hair
 will be pulled out. Employ the same method
 for the chin. After about a fortnight, the roots
 of the hair will be destroyed or they become
 too weak to grow back. Skin will become
 softer. A similar method, if needed can be
 applied to the growth of pubic hair. Medication
 can be employed along with it.
Laser surgery or : Unwanted hair can be removed by a
Electrolysis competent surgeon by laser surgery or
 electrolysis. Lasers destroys the hair follicle
 underneath the skin and retards their future
 growth.
A TOTAL CARE HAIR OIL
Armoracia sat. Q, : Mix 5 ml of each with 100 ml of Arnica
Embelica off. Q, mont. oil. Rubbing the scalp with this mix-Ceanothus Q ture will stop falling of hair, make them darker
 and cure dandruff in many recent cases. Also
 helpful in vertigo and headaches in many cases.
NOTE 1: Normally each hair on the scalp grows continuously for 2 to 4 years,
 then stops growing for 2 to 4 months and then falls out. In its place
 new healthy hair begins to grow and the cycle is repeated. On an
 average, there are approximately 100000 hair follicles in the scalp.
 Normally upto 100 hair are shed daily.
NOTE 2: Hair need protection and care during winter months just as it does
 with the summer sun and humidity. Cold, cold winds and excessive
 heat zap moisture from the hair often leaving it dry and brittle.
 Keeping the head covered during extreme winter and warm days
 helps hair to feel soft and manageable.
330 HANDS

NOTE 3: By adapting healthier eating habits and consuming protein packed
 foods like meats, chicken, fish, eggs and milk, hair loss can ease
 generally and normal growth can resume in months. Vitamins A,
 B2, folic acid, iodine, copper, amino acids, mostly found in green
 leafy vegetables, play a significant role in hair maintenance.

 HANDS
Aconitum nap. (tds) : Hands hot and feet cold.
Apis mel. (tds) : Tips of the fingers and hands become swollen
 and numb.
Bovista (tds) : Due to the sensation of mind, stammering and
 awkwardness result and occasionally he can
 not hold things and they fall from the hands.

 HAY FEVER
 It is an acute, irritating, inflammation of the eyes and upper respiratory

occasionally by bronchitis and asthma. The episodes recur annually at the same

flower, etc.

 Hoarseness and headache. Watering of eyes.
 Sneezing worse entering a warm room and

Ambrosia (tds) : Lachrymation and intolerable itching of the

340 HEADACHE—HEARING - IMPAIRED

NOTE: Although the brain recieves the pain messages from the body but it
 has no pain nerves of its own. Headaches do not indicate any brain
 problem. Such pains originate from the muscles and blood vessels of
 the head.

 HEARING - IMPAIRED
 Hearing loss is generally gradual and painless in many cases developing
so slowly that it is barely noticeable. At any age, hearing can be damaged by :
 1. Middle ear infection.
 2. Exposure to loud or constant noise.
 3. Heredity.
 4. Illness or birth defects.
 5. The natural aging process.
 6. Traumatic injury.
 7. Tumors.
 It is suggested that after the age of 50, a regular hearing test must be done.
It should also be done whenever hearing becomes impaired. Treatment should
be done on the basis of the disease. In most of the cases (90%), it will be
necessary to have a hearing aid which should be used on the advise of an ear
specialist. In the rest of the 10% cases, the following medicines are suggested.
Please refer to “Deafness” also.

 defects mentioned above.
Arnica mont. (qid) : Hearing impaired due to a blow or an injury

 Indicated in infancy and old age when the

 that often comes too late, after the damage has been done.

 Tobacco heart from chewing. Intermittent
 action of the heart in feeble persons with
 hepatic obstruction. One of the best heart

Vipera (tds) : Dropsy of heart with swelling of veins, face,

NOTE 1: Exercise, diet, weight control, controlling of blood pressure, stopping
 the use of drugs and smoking avoid the risk of heart diseases.
NOTE 2: A team of scientists at The University of Pennsylvania confirmed after
 a research, that use of vitamin E gives protection against atherosclerosis
 characterized by fatty deposits in the arterial linings of the
 cardiovascular system, and protects against thickening, hardening and
 loss of the walls of blood vessels and confers “Patient Protection” from
 heart disease.
NOTE 3: The chances of heart attack are more if any or many of the below risk
 factors are present in a person:
 (a) Smoking.
 (b) High blood pressure.

348 HEART—HEART ATTACK

 (c) Elevated blood cholesterol.
 (d) Inactive life style.
 (e) Over-weight.
 (f) Diabetes.
 (g) Stress (how one reacts to physical, mental or emotional tension).
NOTE 4: Heart diseases are mostly caused due to the death of a heart muscle.
 Heart muscles become starved for oxygen when cholesterol and fatty
 deposits clog the blood ways.
NOTE 5: The heart beats roughly 100,000 times a day, pumps about 5 litres of
 blood every minute, pumps nearly 23000 litres of blood per day, pumps
 the entire blood supply around the body about once every minute, and
 is about the size of one’s fist.

 HEART ATTACK
 (MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION)

 Site of blockage in
 coronary artery

 Area of the heart
 affected

 A heart attack occurs when the blood supply to the heart muscle is se-verely reduced or stopped. This happens when one of the arteries (coronary
 HEART ATTACK—HEELS 349

arteries) supplying blood to the heart muscle is blocked. If the blood supply to
the heart muscle is cut off for longer than several minutes, muscle cells in the
affected area suffer irreversible injury and die. As the heart cannot reproduce,
heart muscle damage from the heart attack is permanent. A heart attack can
result in disability or even death depending on how much and where the heart
muscle is damaged. Over 90% of the heart attacks are caused by a blood clot
in the coronary artery (coronary thrombosis or coronary occulusion). The for-mation of blood clots is often associated with atherosclerosis, the build up of
plague (a combination of cholesterol, cellular waste and other materials) on
the artery wall. When the plague ruptures, it can form a blood clot capable of
blocking one of the coronary arteries. Serious atherosclerosis can also cause a
heart attack by “blocking off” the flow of blood through the coronary artery.
Heart attacks can also occur by severe contraction or spasm in one of the
coronary arteries. When this happens, the artery narrows and blood supply to
the heart muscle is decreased or even stopped. It can occur in the normal ap-pearing blood vessels and vessels partly blocked by atherosclerosis.
 Paleness, anxiety, fear, sweating, shortness of breath, indigestion, tight-ness or chest pain, over all weakness and nausea are general symptoms of a
heart attack. Some individuals, particularly women may experience vague chest
discomfort or think that they are having heartburn. Symptoms can come and
go. Such a patient should immediately be referred to the nearest hospital or a
heart specialist. About 40 percent of such patients die within 30 minutes of the
attack.

 IMMUNE SYSTEM
 (LYMPHATIC SYSTEM)

 The immune lymphatic system is an infection fighting circulatory system
 of body fluids and lymphocytes travelling in delicate vessels called ducts that
 collect fluid squeezed from veins during normal metabolism, and bring it back
 to the veins near the heart. The lymphatic fluid resembles blood serum, that is,
 blood fluid containing only lymphocytes (white blood corpuscles without cy-Thoracic duct

increase to 90 % in lymphatic leukemia) and is returned to the blood stream at
various parts of the body so that the waste products can be removed by the
kidneys. The lymphatic system also includes various infection fighting or lym-phocyte producing organs such as the spleen, tonsils, appendix, thymus and
intestinal Peyer’s patches. A lymph node is a kidney or bean-shaped bin occuring
along the lymphatic ducts. There are hundreds of them. It filters the lymphatic
fluid and removes the disease forming materials. They stop cancer cells and in
turn may become the seat of cancer themselves. The filtered pure lymph enters
the main trunk for absorption into the blood. The lymph nodes are of the size
of a pinhead to the size of an olive or an almond. Lymph is transparent but in
the vessels draining the intestines, it is milky in color due to the presence of
fats and is called “chyle”.

DISEASES OF THE IMMUNE SYSTEM

1. Lymphoma (tumor in the lymphatic vessel): Lymphoma is a general term
 for growth of a new tissue in the lymphatic vessel. It can be of a low form,
 that is, it is non-malignant or it can be malignant and a lymphosarcoma.
 Many lymphomas arise within the lymph node but they can be anywhere
 - within the areas of intestines, bone marrow, etc. It is a disease of the
 white blood cells.

 MOTILITY (REFLUX)
 (SEE ‘REGURGITATION’ ALSO)

 Everyone has experienced stomach discomfort or a bloated feeling at some
point in their lives. But when it occurs regularly, it becomes a problem.
 Many people instinctively reach for an antacid, thinking the discomfort is
caused by excess acid.But often, they have normal healthy levels of acid (what
the stomach needs to help process food). More likely, the problem is one of
motility or reflux.
 INDIGESTION DUE TO DEFECTIVE MOTILITY 391

 Motility is the natural wave-like action that moves food through the
digestive system. When it's not working properly, food sits in the stomach and
can cause discomfort, bloating and other symptoms. The pressure can also
force stomach contents up, causing heartburn.
 The solution is to get things moving again, and by restoring motility,
relieve the stomach discomfort and other symptoms.
 Reflux occurs when the lower esophageal sphincter is weak or relaxed,
allowing stomach contents to flow back into the esophagus. This irritates the
esophageal lining which is less protected than the stomach lining and causes
heartburn. Diet and lifestyle modifications are an important part of the treatment.
Remedies as suggested in the chapter “Acidity” are helpful. Drinking a glass
of water during the attack flushes down the food giving relief.

 When a lady is unable to have a child even aften a prolonged medical
treatmant, many a couples employ high technical treatment and enjoy the joys
of parenthood. Any of the following six procedures can be employed, only by
a competent surgeon who specialized in this kind of treatment:
1. Intracytoplasmic sperm infection (I.C.S.I): Man’s sperm is injected
 directly into his wife’s egg under a microscope. The embryo is then
 implanted in the woman’s womb.
2. Ovulation induction: A woman who is unable to produce eggs, is treated
 to produce a lot of eggs. The intercourse is timed for an optimal period
 of the woman’s cycle to create the pregnancy.
3. Intra-uterine insemination (I. U. I.): Man’s sperm are collected and are
 placed directly in the woman’s uterus. This type of insemination helps if
 the man has a low count of sperms or they are slow in movement which
 hampers their journey to the woman’s egg.
4. Invitro fertilization : Some of the woman’s eggs are combined with the
 husband’s sperms in a petridish. If fertilization takes place, the embryo
 is transferred into the woman’s uterus.
5. Gametic intra-fallopian transfer : An egg and sperm are directly
 transferred into the fallopian tubes and on fertilization, it travels to the
 uterus.
6. Another woman’s egg or another man’s sperm are employed to produce
 the embryo which is then planted in the uterus of the barren woman.
NOTE 1: It is said that for obtaining a male child, the woman should take
 Natrium mur. 6x one dose daily and for obtaining a female child,
 she should take Pulsatilla nig. 6x one dose daily from 3rd to 6th
 month of pregnancy.
NOTE 2: Aurum mur. CM , one dose given at the commencement of pregnancy
 usually results in the birth of a male child.
NOTE 3: Doctors at the genetics and I.V.F. Institute Fairfax Va are researching
 that a baby of choice-male or female can be produced. The only
 difference between male producing Y chromosome sperm and female
 producing X chromosome sperm is that Y chromosome sperms have
 about 2.8 percent less genetic material.

 and can be resolved by a change of prescription. Still others are caused

 good nights rest:
 1. Maintain a regular sleep schedule. Getting up at the same time every
 morning synchronizes the body’s biological clock.
 2. Keep the bedroom for sleeping. Do not read,watch TV or eat in
 bed.
 3. If you do not fall asleep within 20 minutes of going to bed, get up
 and read or listen to quite music until you get sleepy.
 4. Limit daytime naps.
 5. Take a 20 to 30 minutes warm bath before bed.
 6. Drink a glass of milk just before bed (warm or cold).
 7. Avoid caffeinated beverages and chocalate in the afternoon and
 evening.
 8. Don’t drink alcohol before bed time. It can cause sleeplessness at
 night.
 9. Exercise during the day but not before going to bed.
 10. According to Dr Anna Wirz - justice leader of the research team at
 Psychiatric University Clinic of Chronobiology and Sleep
 Laboratory, Switzerland, keeping the hands and feet warm in a
 cold bedroom induces sleep quickly

NOTE: In pulmonary fibrosis, scar tissue forms in the lungs. The scarring
 damages the alveoli where exchange of oxygen and carbon dioxide
 takes place in the lungs. It is neither a cancer nor is it contagious.
 One of the causes is inhaling of fine metal or other solid particles.
 When the cause is not known, it is called idiopathic pulmonary
 fibrosis. Dry cough and shortness of breath are the first visible signs.
 It is confirmed by X-rays or CT scan or biopsy. Conventional
 treatment consists of administration of corticosteriods and in
 homeopathy the inflammation is reduced by the above remedies

 LUPUS
 (ULCERATING SKIN DISEASE)

Structure : This is a form of epithelial cancer and is also

Symptoms : It first appears on the nose as a hard, dusky

Causes : Lupus is caused by disruption of body waste
 disposal system from failure of special enzyme
 “D Nasil” which fails to remove wastes from
 the body.
Diagnostic tests : The disease is easily noticeable as it is outside
 the body on the skin and biopsy is performed
 to confirm it.

NOTE 1: In 1851, the French dermatologist Cazenave employed the Latin term

 MENOPAUSE
 (CHANGE OF LIFE)

 In women, it occurs between 35-55 years of life. Menses may stop
suddenly or there maybe decreased flow each month until there is a final
cessation or the periods maybe lengthened until complete cessation is
accomplished. Surgical menopause occurs in almost 50% of women aged 50-64 years. It is surgically induced by removal of ovaries irrespective of age,
characterizing end of child bearing years. In men, it is called “andropause”
(instead of menopause) and generally occurs between the age of 50-60 years
when some changes in his behavior maybe noticed. When the menstruation of
a woman halts, the estrogen level begins to drop.
 The decrease in production of “estrogen” results in thinning of vagina and
loss of elasticity of mucous membranes of vulva, vagina and other tissues like
that of breasts. It also causes dryness of vagina and its itching, and sometimes
discomfort or pain during sexual intercourse. For the same reason, the urinary
stream maybe slowed down, there maybe difficulty in urination, increase in
urination both during the day and night and voiding of urine on coughing or
sneezing or urine may escape if the urge to it is not attended to immediately.
Fatigue, insomnia, headache, irritability, depression, loss of memory and
concentration are series of conditions associated with climacteric. All these
symptoms have been dealt with under the appropriate heads and maybe
consulted in case of need. One more condition that occurs in the post-menopausal period over the age of 50 is called ‘osteoporosis’. Research has
shown that almost 25% women in this period suffer from this disease. In this
disease, amount of bone being produced by the body falls short of the amount
that is naturally lost over time and excessive calcification of bones occurs
causing spontaneous fractures and a marble-like appearance. For this also
refer to the chapter on bones and fractures. Calcarea phos. and Symphytum
off. (tincture) will be found useful. Weight bearing exercises, calcium
supplements and soyabean foods are helpful during this difficult period of
change of life. During this period, ovaries shut down and female eggs are not
produced. It is estimated that women are born with 800000 eggs but the number
dwindles with age. At about 37, about 25000 eggs are left, the decline speeds
up and ovaries shrink until most of the eggs are depleted and menopause occurs
around 50, plus or minus seven or eight years.

 MILK
 Milk is one of the most precious gifts of nature. It is a perfect food and
contains all the nourishment for growth like vitamin A, B, C and D in sufficient
quantities. It has sugar and fats just in the right quantity.It is easily digested
and is an essential diet for all infants, children - young or old, ladies and men.It

which are present in the mother’s milk, number of enzymes, proteins, etc. If it
causes disorders, the following remedies can be used to remove the disorders.

 Choosing to breast feed is one of the best things a mother can do for her
baby. It has tremendous advantages for the mother and her baby. It develops a
close relationship between the child with the mother. Nature has formulated
mother’s milk specially for her child. It provides all the nutrients needed in an
ideal proportion. As the baby grows, the nutrient contents of mother’s milk
also change to satisfy the infants growth and changing needs. Breast milk is
safe, convinient and always at the perfect temperature. It is available whenever
the baby needs it. Several studies indicate that breast feeding may induce an

just want to lose 5-10 pounds. To get restored to a more normal body and to

after dieting is abondoned.

bulimia. There are no magic pills.

 a. Exogenous: It is caused by excessive food intake. In such cases diet

 b. Endogenous: It is caused by some abnormality within the body
 like adrenal hyperfunction or testicular or ovarian or thyroid
 hypofunction.

NOTE 2 : Obesity can be from any of the following causes:
 a. Hyperinsulinemia:This disorder causes the body to over- produce
 insulin hormone. Insulin turns carbohydrates into fat. The extra
 insulin starves the brain of the glucose and disrupts the entire
 endocrine system which creates mood swings, constant fatigue and
 food cravings causing obesity. In addition to the homeopathic oral
 treatment, low consumption of carbohydrate diet and high protein
 diet helps cure obesity.
 b. Prader -Willi syndrome: It is a congenital medical disorder which
 results in compulsive over -eating causing obesity. It is curable.
 c. Hyperthyroidism: It is a curable condition.
 d. Cholesterol: High level of cholesterol causing obesity can also be
 cured.

 body remains normal but the hips and thighs become fat. It is

NOTE 3: It is important that in cases of obesity, the cause should be determined

 OSTEOPOROSIS
 Osteoporosis is a condition characterized by the loss of normal density
of bone, resulting in fragile bone. It leads to literally abnormally porous bone
that is more compressible like a sponge, than dense like a brick. This disorder
of the skeleton weakens the bone causing an increase in the risk for fracture.
Normal bone is composed of protein, collagen, and calcium all of which gives
bone its strength. Bones that are affected by osteoporosis can break with
relatively minor injury that normally would not cause a bone fracture. The
fracture can be either in the form of cracking, or collapsing. The spine, hips,
and wrists are common areas of bone fractures from osteoporosis, although
osteoporosis-related fractures can also occur in almost any skeletal bone.
 The strength of the bones can be determined by bone mass (bone
density). Generally, the higher the bone density, the stronger are the bones.
Bone density is greatly influenced by genetic factors, which in turn are
sometimes modified by environmental factors and medications. Normally, bone
density accumulates during childhood and reaches a peak by around age 25.
It is then maintained for about ten years. After age 35, both men and women
will normally lose 0.3% to 0.5% of their bone density per year as part of the
ageing process. Estrogen is important in maintaining bone density in women.
When estrogen levels drop after menopause bone loss accelerates. Accelerated
bone loss after menopause is a major cause of osteoporosis in women. Patients
with osteoporosis have no symptoms until bone fractures occur.

 For pains, in a particular part of the body or an organ, see under the
appropriate heading. Following are the general characteristics of pains. These
have proved to be a useful guide but it is not all.
 How pain travels
 Despite years of research, questions still remain about exactly what
happens between the moment you step on a nail and the moment you say
“ouch”. Scientists are scrambling to answer these questions in their search for
new pain relievers.
1. Receptors at the end of nerves in the skin, muscles, bone, blood vassels
 and internal organs detect a potentially harmful stimulus.
2. A pain message in the form of electrical impulses travels along the nerve to
 the spinal cord.
3. The pain message enters the dorsal horn, where the peripheral nerve
 releases chemical transmitters that activate a number of nerve cells in the
 spinal cord.
4. The spinal cord processes the information and transmits it to the brain via
 other nerve cells. The spinal cord usually sends a signal for the muscles to
 contract, to move the limb away from pain.
5. The message is forwarded to several specialized regions of the brain that
 control physical sensation, emotional feeling and thinking.

 and sticks on the tongue. It falls at the back of

 nares in the throat.
 PHLEGM—PHOTOPHOBIA—PHTHISIS—PILES—PITUITARY GLAND 545

Natrium carb. (tds) : Catarrh of the posterior nares. Hawking much
 mucus from the throat, worse slightest draught.
Natrium mur. (tds) : Mucus like the white of an egg or transparent

 and taste.
Phytolacca dec. (tds) : Flow of mucus from one nostril and from the
 posterior nares.
Pulsatilla nig. (tds) : Yellow mucus with a stuffed nose and with pain
 above the eyes or in the right cheek bone. The
 patient has a weeping tendency.

 PHOTOPHOBIA
 (DREAD OF LIGHT)

 PIMPLES

Anterior pituitary (Adenohypophysis)

 Neurohypophysis
 Adenohypophysis

NOTE : The pituitary gland regulates the release of growth hormone. People

 PLAGUE

Iodium (tds) : Acts prominently on corrective tissues and

Operculina turp. (tds) : Plague with fever and diarrhea. Lymphatic

 PLEURISY 547

 PLEURISY
 (INFLAMMATION OF THE PLEURA)

 Exudate on both, parietal and
 visceral layers — pale grey

 Adhesions between layers of pleura

 Small quantity of fluid at base of cavity

 Above the fluid, the fibrin covered
 layers of pleura are adherent

 Lung is collapsed by fluid
 pressure

 Diaphragm depressed by fluid

Aconitum nap. (tds) : It should be the first remedy which should be
 thought in a case of chest pains. Bryonia should
 be given if it fails to relieve in one day.

 muscular tissues and membranes enclosing the
 heart. Excessive dyspnea and cough with much
 mucus secretion. Accumulation of fluids in the
 pleura (pleural effusion), and catarrhal
 pneumonia.
Arnica mont. (tds) : Pleurisy resulting from injury inflicted by a
 broken rib may yield completely to the use of
 this medicine. If a supplement is needed,
 Bryonia and Kalium carb. compete for choice.

548 PLEURISY—PNEUMONIA

Arsenicum alb. (tds) : Great restlessness. Drinks often but little at a
 time. Burning pains in the chest relieved by
 warmth.
Bryonia alba (tds) : Stitching pains in the chest worse by any
 motion and better by rest and cold things. Dry
 pleurisy.
Cantharis (tds) : Great burning in the chest and also burning in
 the urethra when urinating.
China off. (tds) : Pleurisy with fever and great weakness.
Hepar sulphuris (tds) : Pleurisy complicated with bronchitis.
 Formation of pus in the chest. Wet pleurisy.
Kalium carb. (tds) : Breathlessness. Burning pains in the chest.
 Cough.
Kalium sulph. (tds) : Applicable in the later stages of the
 inflammation. Rattling of mucus in the chest.
 Yellow expectoration and pus formation.
Ranunculus bulb. (tds) : Pain in the muscles of the ribs. Chilliness in
 the chest when walking in open air. Rheumatic
 pains in the chest. Pleurodynia.
NOTE: In pleurisy, rest is essential. The patient should have no more exercise
 than bathroom privileges. Increase the fluid intake. In acute cases,
 the affected side should be strapped to immobilize the chest.

 PNEUMONIA
Arsenicum iod. (tds) : Chronic pneumonia when abscess is about to
 form in the lung.
Aconitum nap. (tds) : A remedy for the first stage of pneumonia. A
 high fever preceded by chill. The pulse is hard
 and the skin is dry. Dry painful cough. The
 cause maybe dry cold winds. When thick
 expectoration starts, Aconitum nap. ceases to
 be the remedy.
Antimonium tart. (tds) : Great rattling of mucus but very little is
 expectorated and that also with some effort.
 Threatened paralysis of the lungs.
 PNEUMONIA 549

Arsenicum alb. (tds) : Dyspnea. Thirst, drinks often but little. Fever
 with restlessness.
Bryonia alba (tds) : If the above remedies fail to cure, use of this
 remedy is indicated. Cough is loose and there
 are sharp sticking pains in the chest.
 Breathlessness; the patient wants to be still.
Chelidonium (tds), : Fan-like movements of alae nasi. Pain under
Lycopodium (tds) the corner of right shoulder blade is a sure
 indication for the use of Chelidonium.
Ferrum phos. 6x (qid) : In the beginning of the disease or in the later
 stages when there is bleeding from the lungs.
 Repeat it every 2 hours. A suitable remedy for
 fever.
Iodium 3x (tds) : It can be indicated in any stage of pneumonia.
 There is cough and difficulty in breathing. The
 sputum is bloody. Repeat it every hour when
 indicated.
Ipecacuanha (tds) : Nausea. Wheezing cough. Chest feels full of
 phlegm but does not yield to cough. Pneumonia
 in children.
Kalium mur. (tds) : This remedy in alternation with Ferrum phos.
 has achieved very good results in this disease.
 The mucus is thick and white.
Lycopodium (tds) : Neglicted, maltreated and imperfectly treated
 cases of pneumonia are cured by the use of the
 remedy.
Phosphorus 200 (hs) : Give one dose if Antimonium tart. and Bryonia
 fail. It follows Bryonia very well. This remedy
 is more often indicated and gives curative
 results.
Tuberculinum 1M (hs) : Broncho-pneumonia in children. Hard hacking
 cough. Profuse sweat and loss of weight. Rales
 all over the chest.
Veratrum vir. (tds) : Extreme congestion of the chest, oppression
 of breathing. Dyspnea. Nausea and vomiting.
LEGIONNAIRES DISEASE

 This illness is a form of penumonia found naturally. People are exposed
550 PNEUMONIA—POLIO

to the bacteria when they breathe in air contaminated with droplets of water
containing the organism. Symptoms include high fever, chills and cough as
well as fatigue, headache, muscle pain, chest pain and loss of appetite. This
bacteria best thrives in warm water and often spreads through air conditioning
water and plumbing systems. The treatment is the same as for pneumonia and
on symptoms.

 POLIO
Calcarea phos. 12x (tds), : Two grains of each mixed together, 3 doses
Natrium mur. 12x (tds), a day for 3 months. All the medicines
Kalium Phos. 12x (tds), should be stopped during this course.
Embelica off. (hs) : 10 drops a dose in the morning daily for few
 months.
Gelsemium 6-CM : In increasing potencies, it cures polio. Use 6
 potency, 2 doses per day for a month, 30
 potency 2 doses per day for a month and 200
 potency, one dose every 5th day for 2 months
 and CM potency, one dose a month for 3
 months till cured.
Hypericum 12x (bd) : Two doses a day for 1-3 months in the morning
 and at noon.
Lathyrus sat. 30 (bd) : Two doses daily for 1-3 months in the evening
 and at bed time.
Thuja occ. 200 (hs) : Start the treatment with this remedy. No other
 remedy should be given on that day.
NOTE: Watch the following symptoms of post polio syndrome for the
 indicated remedy:
 1. Unaccustomed fatigue requiring the patient to rest during mid-day or earlier.
 2. New joint and muscular pains.
 3. Muscular weakness or loss of muscle use even in the muscles which
 did not bother while suffering from polio.
 4. Respiratory or swallowing problems.
 5. Unusual intolerance of cold which causes muscular weakness or a
 burning pain or discoloration of limbs.
 6. Psychological stress.
 POLYPUS 551

 POLYPUS
 (SOFT TUMOR)

 Gross edema

 Dilated blood
 vessels Polypi

 Thickened
 basement
 membrane

 Lymphocytes,
 plasma cells
 and frequently
 Adenoid
 eosinophilia

 An abnormal growth from the mucous membrane resembling a tumor but
not cancerous; commonly found in the nose, uterus, rectum and sometimes in
the ear and larynx. There is a risk of the polyp becoming cancerous or increasing
in size or number.
Alumina (tds) : Polypus of the left nostril of the nose. The
 peculiar constipation confirms the use of this
 remedy.
Berberis vulg. (tds) : Polypus of the vocal cord without roots and
 having an angry reddish look.
Calcarea carb. 200 (hs) : A good remedy for polypus of the nose, ear,
Repeat after one week bladder, uterus, etc. It should be repeated after
 7 days. Mucus polypus which bleeds easily.
Calcarea iod. 3x (tds) : Polypi of the nose and ear.
Calcarea phos. (tds) : A large polypus of the nose extending to the
 brain.
Cholesterinum (tds) : Polypus of the gall bladder in a pre-cancerous
 stage. Burning pain in the liver region. General
 debility.
552 POLYPUS

Conium mac. (tds) : Uterine polypus which protrudes while passing
 urine. Bleeding polypus of the nose.
Formica rufa (tds) : Stops development of polypi and reduces the
 size. It is an effective remedy, specially for
 polypi of the ears.
Kalium bich. (tds) : Polypus of the air passages.
Kalium nit. (tds) : Polypus of the nose or elsewhere specially on
 the right side with headache or heaviness of
 the head after eating and in the morning or
 towards the evening.
Lachesis 200 (hs) : Polypus of the left ear with severe pain. Sensi-Repeat after a week tive to air.
Lemna minor (tds) : Nasal polypi. Swollen mucous membranes of
 the nose. Atrophic rhinitis. Fetid smell.
 Reduces the obstruction of the nose by
 reducing the swelling.
Mercurius sol. (tds) : Polypus. Blockage of the ear, bleeds easily
 and affects the hearing. Right ear is mostly
 involved.
Phosphorus (bd) : Nasal polypi bleeding easily. Handkerchief is

 cold drinks. Sneezing. Polypus of the uterus.
Sanguinaria (tds) : Polypus of the nose or larynx. Smarting and
 burning in the nose and throat. Nose
 obstructed. Bleeding from removal of crusts.
Sepia (tds) : Polypi of uterus with copious menses.
Silicea 6x (tds) : Blockage of nose; nostrils inflamed. Patient

Taxus baccata Q : Bright red polypus of the ear with shooting

 dose gives results.
Teucrium mar. CM (hs) : It is one of the best remedies for polypus of
Repeat after 15 days the nose. Three - four doses repeated after an
 interval of 15 days usually cures permanently.
 It cures polypus of the rectum also. Blockage
 of the nose on the side patient lies on. It cures
 polypus of vagina too. Polypus is soft and of
 jelly-like consistency.
 POLYURIA 553

Thuja occ. 20 (hs) : Polypus of the middle ear and uterus with a
Repeat after a week chronic tendency.

 POLYURIA

Alfalfa Q (bd) : Polyuria. Frequent urging to urinate.
10 drops in ½ cup of water

 straining to pass it. The urine is burning and

Argentum nit. (tds) : Frequent and profuse urination.

Chelidonium (tds) : Frequent desire. Urine is copious. Maybe

 and after passing urine.

Ledum pal. (tds) : Polyuria. Urine maybe copious or little. The

Nux vomica (tds) : Frequent urination on account of indigestion.

 urine. Has to rush to urinate or it escapes.
Sabal ser. Q (tds) : Prostate gland enlarged. Constant desire to
10 drops in ½ cup of water pass urine.

10 drops in ½ cup of water every 15 minutes or so due to inflammation of
 the bladder or a kidney trouble. Blood, pus,
 albumin, etc. in the urine is cured by the use of
 this remedy.

10 drops in ½ cup of water sickness’. Constant nausea and vomiting in
 pregnant women and also gastric and intestinal
 irritation.
Anacardium ori. (tds) : Dyspepsia and insomnia.
 PREGNANCY 555
