Arnica mont. : For mis-step or an accident during pregnancy
 - when the miscarriage is threatened, repeat
 every 15 minutes till the desired results are
 achieved.
Bellis per. (tds) : Backache and inability to walk.
Cocculus ind. (tds) : Bleeding during pregnancy due to lack of
 sleep. Clotted blood with spasmodic colic.
 Nausea and backache specially of light haired
 and romantic females.
Conium mac. (tds) : Breasts become painful. Constipation.
Ficus ind. Q (tds) : It is a very useful remedy for all sorts of
10 drops in ½ cup of water abnormal bleeding before and after pregnancy.
Gratiola off. (tds) : Vertigo. Dyspepsia, dysphagia, cramps and
 colic with wind in the abdomen. Constipation
 or diarrhea - stool forcibly evacuated without
 pain.
Ipecacuanha (tds) : Nausea and vomiting in pregnancy.
Kalium carb. (tds) : For weakness in general.
Lac def. (tds) : Vomiting during the first quarter of pregnancy.
Magnesium carb. (tds) : Toothache during pregnancy.
Manganum acet. (tds) : Desire for always lying down in bed.

Calcarea phos. (tds) sand, etc.

556 PREGNANCY

 unborn child is not normal i.e., head is not below
 and is upside or lying sideways. It also avoids
 displacement of the uterus and keeps it in the
 right place.
Secale cor. 6 (tds) : Discharge of blood during pregnancy.
Sepia (tds) : It is a good remedy for toothache or
 constipation during pregnancy. It is useful
 when there is always an urgent desire to void
 urine and if not voided in time, a few drops

 pregnancy. Unusual bleeding during pregnancy

 pregnancy.

 pregnancy.
Sulphur (od) : Sensation in the abdomen as if a child is
 kicking from inside.
Sulphur 6 (od), : If a women gives birth habitually to babies who

 each feed.

 pregnancy. The leading symptom is relief from

Symphytum off. (tds) : Persistent vomiting.
Tabacum 200 (hs) : Vomiting during pregnancy with much spitting

Thuja occ. (tds) : Violent movements and kicking of the child

 urinate on account of pressure on the urinary
 bladder.
 PREGNANCY—PRE-MENSTRUAL SYNDROME 557

Tuberculinum 200 (hs) : Always in best of health during pregnancy
 and then goes down rapidly after confinement.
Viburnum prun. Q (bd) : 5 drops a dose will cure cramps during
 pregnancy.
NOTE 1: It is said that for obtaining a male child, the woman should take
 Natrium mur. 6x, one dose daily and for obtaining a female child,
 Pulsatilla 6x, one dose daily from 3rd to 5th month of pregnancy. In
 the first weeks of gestation, male and female embryos develop a like
 — both start with what are called undifferentiated gonads that can
 turn out to be ovaries or testes and will all become females except for
 the intervention of contain factors that put us into the male line. For
 those factors to operate, the Y chromosome is needed. Females have
 an XX sex chromosome compound and man XY which is genetically
 determined the moment the sperm fertilizes the egg. It is the Y
 portion that ultimately decides to build testes or breasts.
NOTE 2: Aurum mur. CM (one dose) given at the time of commencement of
 pregnancy usually results in birth of a male child.
NOTE 3: More and more women are now opting for a caesarean section because
 it is easy and safe. It is advantageous when the baby is in a wrong
 position for a vaginal birth and where the woman does not want any
 more children. The risk of complications grows with each surgery.
 Now the surgery can be performed while the woman is awake using
 modern anesthetics. A small incision is made which is less disfiguring
 than the previous method.

 PRE-MENSTRUAL SYNDROME
 (P.M.S.)
Calcarea carb. (tds) : PMS with fluid retention, particularly swollen
 tender breasts, painful joints, weakness, lack
 of energy, depression, tearfulness, irritability,

 ones. Irritability, tearfulness, difficulty in
 concentrating, a desire to get away from
558 PRICKLY HEAT—PROLAPSUS

 PRICKLY HEAT

 PROLAPSUS

RECTUM

UTERUS
Aloe soc. (tds) : Prolapse of the uterus with diarrhea.
Belladonna (tds) : Bearing down with sensation as if everything

 PROLAPSUS 559

Kalium carb. 200 (hs) : Prolapse of the uterus after labor. One dose
Repeat after 1 week after 7 days if necessary. Not to be repeated
 often.
Lachesis (bd) : Prolapse of uterus during menopause.

Natrium mur. (tds) : Prolapse uteri with cutting in the urethra.
 Bearing down pains worse in the morning.
Podophyllum (tds) : Prolapse of uterus after delivery of a child.
Pulsatilla nig. (tds) : Bearing down sensation with pains worse lying
 down.
Sepia (tds) : It is the most effective remedy in prolapsus
 uteri, misplacement of the uterus or its
 inversion, etc. It restores the uterus to the
 normal position within a few days without
 manual intervention even in 30 potency. Higher
 potencies will work well in chronic cases. Must
 cross limbs to prevent protrusion of parts.

 uterus. It also strengthens the ligaments of the
 uterus. Prolapse is worse during passage of
 stool.
Tilia eur. (tds) : Bearing down feeling as if everything will
 protrude out of the vulva. Leucorrhea. Prolapse
 of uterus after labor. Intense sore feeling about
 the uterus.
NOTE: There is a lack of knowledge regarding “Pelvic floor prolapse” which
 mostly occurs in women in this disorder. The pelvic organs, bladder,
 uterus and lower bowel fall down through the vagina. This occurs
 because the pelvic floor muscles can be weakened by aging, childbirth,
 obesity and other factors. In the early stage, urine leaks on sneezing ,
 laughing or coughing. In surgical processes, slings are build to keep
 the organs fallen out of position, back where they belong.

 people.
Cadmium phos. (tds) : Useful in suspected carcinoma of the prostate
 gland.
Chimaphila (tds) : Great urge to urinate. Straining necessary to
 commence urination. The urine feels hot when
 passed.
Cistus can. (tds) : Cancer of the prostate gland.
Conium mac. (tds) : Discharge of prostatic fluid on every motion
 with itching of prepuce and enlargement. Urine
 starts and stops again and again.
Crotalus hor. (tds) : Cancer with bleeding of the prostate gland.
Digitalis (tds) : Constant urging to pass urine which comes in
 drops with a cutting and throbbing pain in the
 bladder.
Eupatorium purp. (tds) : Enlargement of prostate gland with burning in
 bladder and urethra on urinating. Dysuria.
 Polyuria. Constant desire to void urine.
Ferrum pic. 3x (tds) : It is one of the best remedies for enlargement
 of the prostate gland in the aged. Frequent
 urination at night with feeling of fulness and
 pressure in the rectum. Senile hypertrophy of
 the prostate.
Hoang nan Q : Cancer of the prostate gland. Start with 5 drops,
 thrice daily and gradually increase to 20 drops.
Hydrangea Q : Enlargement of the prostate gland without
 any complications, specially in old people. 2
566 PROSTATE GLAND

 doses of 5-10 drops, morning and evening per
 day. Very difficult urination.It also works well
 in 200 and 1000 potency. Urine maybe retained
 specially in men over 50 years of age.
Lycopodium 1M (hs) : Back pain before urination which goes after
Repeat after a month wards. Urine is slow to come and the patient
 strains to pass it. In 1M potency, it is useful
 for the cure of prostate cancer.
Pareira brava (tds) : Retention of urine due to enlargement of the
 prostate gland.
Ferrum met. (od) : Prostatitis, chronic nephritis and high blood
 pressure, difficult mental concentration and
 confusion are removed by the use of this
 remedy in 30th potency.
Sabal ser. (tds) : Burning in urethra while passing urine and
 difficulty in passing urine. Recent or chronic
 enlargements. Sensation of coldness from the
 prostate gland to genitals. Discharge of
 prostatic fluid involuntarily and other prostatic
 troubles. Constant desire to pass urine at night.
Selenium met. (tds) : Discharge of prostatic fluid during stool.
 Prostatis in elderly men. Dribbling of prostatic
 juice during sleep. The use of foods containing
 this metal reduces the risk of prostate cancer.
 It is found in minute quantities in meat, fish,
 whole grains, dairy products and vegetables
 grown in selenium rich soil.
Staphysagria (tds) : Enlargement with frequent urge to pass urine.
 Sensation as if a few drops remained. Burning
 in urethra when not urinating; urging and pain
 after urinating.
Thuja occ. (tds) : Prostatic discharge is thick and green.
 Inflammation of the gland.
Triticum rep. (tds) : Enlarged prostate gland. There is a constant
 desire to pass urine. It emits on sneezing or
 coughing. Can’t hold urine.
Tribulus ter. Q (tds) : 15 drops, thrice daily corrects prostatis and ill-effects of masturbation.
 PROSTATE GLAND—PROSTATORRHEA 567

Turnera Q (bd) : It is useful for the cure of prostatic discharge
10 drops in ½ cup of water which is chronic and accompanied with sexual
 debility.

NOTE 1: Eating tomatoes reduces the risk of prostate cancer. Tomato contains
 vitamins A, B complex, C as well as iron and potassium. Red tomatoes
 contain lycopene which protects against a variety of ailments
 including prostate cancer. Lycopene is also found in water melon
 and papaya.
NOTE2: Excessive use of aluminium in water or in food is believed to be one
 of the major causes of cancer of prostate.
NOTE3: Prostate is a small gland about the size of a chestnut, situated just
 below the bladder. It secretes fluid which transports the sperms
 during ejaculation. Women do not have a prostate.
NOTE4: The prostate gland is not always affected in urinary problems. It is
 best to consult an urologist (i.e., a person who specializes in dealing
 with the urinary tract in both sexes and the genital tract in the males)
 before taking treatment.
NOTE 5: Prostate cancer patients are being effectively treated by using a
 vaccine prepared from their own cancer. Seattle (New Orleans, USA)
 researchers make the vaccine by drawing blood from the prostate
 cancer patients. This vaccine shrinks the prostate tumor and puts a
 hold on its growth.
NOTE 6: A comprehensive study which appeared in the Journal of American
 Medical Association in Jan. 2000, revealed that nearly 66 percent of
 men who had their cancerous prostates removed become impotent
 and more than 8 percent lacked bladder control according to Dr.
 Janet Stanford, Seattle (USA). Impotency results from injury or
 removal of two nerves (that carry signals to the penis to fill with blood
 allowing erections) during surgeries to remove the cancerous prostate
 gland.

 PROSTATORRHEA
 Weakness of the prostate gland causes discharge of prostate juice during
stool, urination and straining.
Acidum phos. 1c (tds) : Prostatic fluid escapes even when passing a
 soft stool. Emissions at night with weakness
 of sexual power.
568 PROSTATORRHEA—PRURITUS

Aesculus hip. 3x (tds) : Prostatorrhea at stool or while straining.
Agnus castus 3x (tds) : Loss of prostatic fluid on straining. Testicles
 are hard and swollen. Sexual weakness or
 impotency.
Alumina (bd) : Prostatic discharge when straining to expel
 stools.
Chimaphila 30 (tds), : Loss of prostate juice with enlargement of the
Sabal ser. 3c (tds) prostate gland. Polyurea.
Selenium met. (tds) : Dribbling of prostatic juice with weakness of
 sexual power and too early ejaculation in
 coitus.
Turnera Q (bd) : Chronic prostatorrhea.
10-20 drops in ½ cup of water

 PRURITUS
Aloe soc. (tds) : Intense itching of the anus and the opening of
 the intestines into it. The patient bores fingers
 into the anus to get relief and gets pleasure in
 rotating the finger in it.
Alumina (tds) : Intense itching of the whole body when getting
 warm in bed. Must scratch until it bleeds and
 then becomes painful. Brittle skin on the
 fingers.
Ambra grisea (tds) : Voluptuous itching of scrotum and pudendum
 with soreness and swelling. Parts numb but
 burn internally. Itching of the urethra.
Borax (tds) : Sensation of distention in clitoris. Itching
 during pregnancy.
Caladium seg. (tds) : Pruritus of vulva and vagina during pregnancy.
Colchicum autum. (tds) : Pruritus of female genitalia. Sensation of
 swelling in vulva and clitoris.
Collinsonia (tds) : Swelling and dark redness of genitals with
 soreness. Pruritus lessens after menses.
 Swelling of labia and clitoris.
 PRURITUS—PSORIASIS 569

Helonias (tds) : Very irritating itching of vulva and vagina.
Medorrhinum 1000 (hs) : Pruritus with intense itching.
Radium brom. (od) : For intense itching of the anus, one dose of 30
 potency each day.
Sepia (tds) : Pruritus of vagina and yellow leucorrhea.
Sulphur (od) : Pruritus due to warmth of bed with burning
 urine. Parts bleed on scratching.
Tarentula his. (tds) : Vulva dry and hot with intense itching.
NOTE 1: Such patients should take a bath daily but too sudden a change in the
 temperature of water should be avoided. Medicated soaps or ointments
 should not be used. If necessary, a glycerine soap maybe used for
 bathing and coconut oil maybe applied gently on the affected parts
 and not rubbed. Locally, the parts can be washed with hydrogen
 peroxide. 1 part of it is mixed with 12 parts of water.
NOTE 2: If hygenic procedures of Note 1 are followed but the indicated remedy
 gives little or no relief, the part giving trouble maybe examined.
 Itching about the anus can be due to pinworms, hemorrhoids or
 residual soap remaining due to improper washing. Itching of external
 female genitalia is often an early sign of diabetes mellitus or
 vaginitis or for not washing properly after sexual intercourse.

 PSORIASIS
 Psoriasis is a chronic skin disorder that causes thick, silvery, scaly, red
patches to appear on the skin. A specific type of arthritis is frequently associated
with the disease.
 It can be on any part of the body but rarely on the face. The cause is
unknown and it responds to homeopathic treatment very well. The treatment
is lengthy and requires patience. The disease lessens in severity in summer
and goes into remission from time to time with no apparent reason.
Arsenicum alb. (tds) : When other symptoms of the remedy are
 present and there is irritation of the skin. Its
 first influence is to make eruptions redder and
 more inflamed. It is a good sign for the use of
 this remedy. There is a burning sensation which
 is relieved by warmth.
570 PSORIASIS

Aurum mur. nat. 3x (tds) : Only for psoriasis syphilitica.
Calotropis Q (bd) : Psoriasis of syphilitic patients in the second
10 drops in ½ cup of water stage when mercury has stopped doing further
 good.
Carcinocinum 1M (hs) : A monthly dose as an intercurrent remedy
 ensures prompt cure.
Chrysarobinum (tds) : If the nails become dull, develop ridges and
 pits, and the cause is psoriasis, give thrice daily.
 Its ointment - 8 grains in an ounce of vaseline
 can be used externally. Vesicular lesions with
 fetid discharge and crust formation. Voilent
 itching. Thighs, legs and ears specially
 affected.
Cicuta vir. (tds) : Spots having burning pains when touched.
 Much irritating eruptions on the ears.
Corallium rub. (tds) : Psoriasis of palms and soles.
Cuprum met. (tds) : Chronic psoriasis. Skin is of bluish color. Few
 spots itch, worse in the folds of joints.
Graphites (od) : If the crusts are sticky and glutaneous, and the
 patient is constipated and cautious.
Hepar sulphuris 200 (od) : Patients over-sensitive to changes in weather
 specially from dry to cold, and desires warmth.
Hydrocotyle 200 (od) : Psoriasis of soles, palms, trunks and
 extremities with circular patches. Circular
 spots with scaly edges. The skin is excessively
 thick and dry.
Ignatia amara 200 (hs) : Aggravation of psoriasis after disputes and
 anger.
Kalium ars. (tds) : Discoloration of the skin after cause of
 psoriasis is removed by this remedy.
Kalium brom. (tds) : Worse on the chest and shoulders, and in very
 rare cases when it spreads to the face also.It is
 a leading remedy for psoriasis.
Lycopodium (tds) : Psoriasis or fungus growth on palms. Skin is
 dry and shrunken.
Manganum acet. (tds) : Psoriasis with painful cracks. Worse at the time
 of menses.
 PSORIASIS 571

Mercurius bin iod. 3x (tds) : Syphilitic and non syphilitic psoriasis.
Mezereum 200 (hs) : Psoriasis of palms; itching worse with warmth.
Petroleum 200 (hs) : Once a week, when there is aggravation by cold
 and in winters. Thick, greenish crusts. Burning
 and itching specially in psoriasis of hands with
 fissures.
Psorinum 200 (hs) : This is a psoriasis nosode and it works when
 the skin looks dirty and there is much itching
 which is worse by the warmth of bed. Crusts
 disappear in summer and reappear in winter.
Radium brom. 200 (hs) : Circular patches of psoriasis all over the
 body.Itching, redness, swelling and extreme
 burning of the skin as if on fire, worse on
 undressing but better in the open air and by a
 hot bath. Arthritis and pains all over the body.
Selenium met. 200 (hs) : Syphilitic psoriasis of palms.
Sulphur 10M (hs) : Start the treatment with this remedy. The
 patient is dirty and has an aversion to bathing.
 Burning and itching. Dry, scaly unhealthy skin.
 The disease is worse in spring time and in damp
 weather. No other remedy should be given for
 24 hours and repeat it after a month.
Thyreoidinum 3x (tds) : It is indicated specially in younger girls.It is
 also useful in distressing itching of the
 disease.It is more indicated in patients with
 thyroid trouble and obesity. Skin is dry.
Tuberculinum 200 (hs) : Chronic psoriasis with intense itching worse
 at night. It is particularly indicated in
 tuberculous children and in patients having a
 history of tuberculous in the family.
Zea italica Q (bd) : When no other remedy is effective, use of this
10 drops in ½ cup of water remedy sometimes proves curative.

NOTE: Psoriasis is believed to be related to incomplete protein digestion,
 alcohol consumption, bowel imbalance, abnormal liver function and
 too much animal fat in diet. Hence, long term dietary changes with
 respect to fat intake may help to bring about improvement. Animal
 fats should be eliminated while oil of seeds included, as it does not
 produce any adverse effect. Similarly, non-vegetarian foods should
572 PUBERTY

 be substituted with vegetarian foods. Alcohol should not be consumed
 during the treatment. It is generally believed that the disease is
 produced by eating a fish suffering from psoriasis but the exact cause
 is still not known.

 PUBERTY
Alumina (tds) : Anemia in girls who have not yet menstruated.
 Pale and livid complexion. Lazziness.
 Impaired appetite and digestion. Chlorosis.
Asafoetida 3x (tds) : Breast swollen and painful. Milk may appear
 in them though they never had pregnancy.
Asterias rub. (tds) : Pimples on the face during puberty.
Aurum met. (tds) : Palpitation of heart at puberty. Foul breath
 from the mouth.
Calcarea carb. (tds) : Leucorrhea before appearance of menses.
Ferrum met. (tds) : Polyuria.
Kalium carb. (tds) : Delayed first menses or menses appeared for
 the first time and then did not appear for several
 months together.
Lycopodium (tds) : Non-development of breasts even at the age
 of 18 years.
Mancinella (tds) : Mentally depressed state at puberty. Sadness
 on account of disappointed love.
Mercurius sol. (tds) : Appearance of milk in breasts, instead of
 menses.
Onosmodium 10M (hs) : Absent breasts appear exceedingly small.
 Breasts may become normal by its use. Use
 one dose every 15 days.
Pituitrinum 30 or 200 (od), : Delayed symptoms of puberty i.e., defective
Zincum met. (tds) development of the breasts, non-growth of hair
 in the armpits and pubis.
Pulsatilla nig. (tds) : This is a remedy for many menstrual troubles
 during puberty. First menstruation is delayed.
 Uncalled sadness or weeping during puberty.
 It also cures irritability during puberty.
Sulphur (od) : Abdomen having the appearance of pregnancy,
 but without it.

chapters.content:
PURGATIVE—PYORRHEA 573

 PURGATIVE
Cascara sag. Q : 15 drops in water thrice daily restores the normal
 functions of the intestines.
Hydrastis Q : In chronic constipation, 3 drops of it in a glass
 of water in the morning is an effective
 purgative. It is best suited to persons who after
 an active life have developed sedentary habits.
Laxative : A glass of cold water on rising in the morning
 with a level teaspoon of common salt makes
 an excellent laxative.

 PYORRHEA
Calendula off. Q : It reduces the inflammation of the gums and
 also avoids formation of pus. 10 drops in an
 ounce of water maybe used as a mouth wash
 and little of it maybe swallowed.
Emetinum 1x : Thrice daily for three days and go on reducing
 gradually. Stop when cured.
Hekla lava (tds) : When there is thick, pus-like discharge and foul
 smell from the mouth.
Kalium carb. (tds) : All the teeth are loose. Bad smell from the
 mouth.
Plantago major Q : It is a clinically reputed remedy for treatment
 of teeth and gum diseases. There is profuse
 flow of saliva and toothache which is better
 by eating. Pain in worse touch, cold air and
 contact. A few drops in warm water can be used
 as a mouth wash.
Mercurius sol. 200 (hs) : It is a remarkable remedy for pyorrhea to avoid
 extraction of teeth, spongy gums and bad odor
 from the mouth.
Rhus g. Q : It can be applied locally on the soft, spongy
 gums. Its use will also cure bad breath, which
 is generally present in cases of pyorrhea.
574 PYORRHEA—QUARRELSOMENESS—QUINSY

Silicea (bd) : It is an excellent remedy for this disease when
 it has taken a chronic form. Painful
 inflammation of the gums with gum boils.
Symphytum off. Q : 2 grams in 8 ounces of water is a good
 application to the gums in these cases.

 QUARRELSOMENESS
Aurum met. (tds) : Peevish at least contradiction. Profound
 depression. Talks of suicide. Over-sensitive.
Ignatia amara (tds) : Sighing and sobbing with changeable moods.
 Melancholic and uncommunicative, the
 symptoms follow shock, grief and
 disappointment.
Nux vomica (tds) : Irritable, cannot bear noise or smell. The patient
 is sunken, fault finding and has a fiery
 temperament.
Petroleum (tds) : Feels that death is near. Irritable, easily
 offended. Vexed at anything.
Sulphur (od) : Lazy, irritable and depressed. Very selfish with
 no regard for others. Hates standing, dislikes
 water and washing.
Tarentula his. (tds) : Sudden changes in moods. Ungrateful and
 discontented.

 QUINSY
(ACUTE INFLAMMATION OF TONSILS WITH
 FEVER)
 (SEE ALSO ‘THROAT’)

Hepar sulphuris 3x (tds) : Extreme pain in the throat on swallowing, one
 sided swelling and inflammation about the
 tonsils, pain often extending to the ear. Three
 doses a day, preferably in water.
 QUINSY—RABIES—RADIATION 575

Hydrastis Q : Used as a gargle in a septic state of the throat
 in malignant scarlet fever, arrests the
 destructive process at once.
Lachesis (od) : There is no remedy so often effective in
 breaking up an attack of quinsy at its
 interception nor in promoting resolution in the
 later stages. Very distressing aggravation after
 sleeping.

 RABIES
 (HYDROPHOBIA)

Anagallis 1x (tds), : These remedies are given symptomatically
Cantharis (tds), and when there is great fear of water.
Xanthinum (tds)
Belladonna 30 (bd) : After 7 days - one dose every evening and
 morning when there is fever and diarrhea.
Hydrophobinum 30 (qid) : Rabies on account of bites of mad animals.
 This remedy should be taken four times a day
 at an interval of two hours each for 7 days.

NOTE: Rabies is a virus that spreads through the central nervous system and
 affects the brain. The virus is usually transmitted through saliva but
 can also be passed on through a cut, scratch or moist tissue in the nose
 and eyes. The symptoms include fever, depression, agitation and
 painful spasms followed by excessive saliva. Death occurs within seven
 days if not treated properly.

 RADIATION
Acidum fluor. : It antidotes radiation caused by X-rays, etc.
576 RASH—REGURGITATION

 RASH
Aconitum nap. (tds) : Rash with sharp fever.
Ammonium carb. (tds) : Scarlet rash, miliary rash, scarlatina.
Belladonna (tds) : Rose rash.
Bryonia alba (tds) : Rash accompanied with constipation.
Ipecacuanha (tds) : Rash accompanied with nausea and difficult
 breathing.
Natrium sulph. 6x (tds) : Red, wart-like eruptions over the whole body.
 Itching worse while undressing, rainy weather
 and after bathing.
Phytolacca dec. (tds) : Measles-like rash - rose colored.
Pulsatilla nig. (tds) : Rash from a disordered stomach.

RASH-DIAPER

Benzoicum acidum (tds) : Diaper rash with urine smelling like ammonia.
Medorrhinum (od) : Diffuse redness all over the diaper area or
 glowing and irritable red rash about the anus
 of the babies.
Sulphur (od) : Diaper rash worse after bathing, better in open
 air. It also cures rash caused by use of certain
 drugs such as bromide or iodine. It is also
 useful for red papular eruptions on the chin
 and anterior chest area of children seen during
 teething due to excessive saliva pouring out
 of the mouth and coming in contact with the
 skin.
NOTE: The best way to prevent diaper rash is to change the diaper as soon it
 becomes wet. Keeping the skin dry is very useful. On the dry skin,
 apply lavender oil. Use of talcum powder should be avoided as it clogs
 the skin pores and prevents healing.

 REGURGITATION
Aethusa cyn. (tds) : Regurgitation of food after about an hour of
 taking it.
 REGURGITATION—REJUVENATION 577

Asafoetida 3x (tds) : Flatulence and regurgitation of liquids with
 pulsations in the pit of the stomach.
Carbo veg. (tds) : Regurgitation of fluids with wind due to
 indigestion.
Carbolicum acidum (tds) : Regurgitation of food with constant belching
 and nausea.
China off. (tds) : Regurgitation of bitter fluid and food worse
 after eating fruits. Belching gives no relief.
Lycopodium (tds) : Regurgitation of food with rolling of flatulence.
Pulsatilla nig. (tds) : Regurgitation of food eaten long before.

 REJUVENATION
Anacardium ori. 200 (od) : People exhausted, their spirit is shattered and
 their memory has suffered, be it after serious
 illness, sexual excesses or the breaking down
 process of old age. The greedy, suspicious,
 malicious, old man can use this remedy for all
 his mental and physical health if relief by eating
 is indicated. It is a leading symptom for the
 use of this remedy.
Calcarea phos. 6x (qid) : Both men and women whose health has been
 broken down by a town residence, missing
 sunshine and open air for a greater part of the
 day and for any reason has become incapable
 of doing much work and whose spirits are
 depressed, are benefited much by the use of
 this remedy.
Magnesium phos. 10M (hs) : It covers the exhaustion and most of the painful
 ailments of which old people often complain
 and a person who looks older than his age.
578 RESTLESSNESS

 RESTLESSNESS
Aconitum nap. (tds) : Physical and mental restlessness. Tossing
 about even in sleep. Frequent nightmares.
 Severe neuralgia with tingling and numbness.
 Thirst is always present and comes with fever.
Aethusa cyn. (tds) : Violent palpitation. Headache and vertigo.
 Anxious and weeping.
Agaricus mus. (tds) : Severe itching. The skin feels as if burning.
Alumina (tds) : Anxious and confused dreams.
Ambra grisea (tds) : Excited and very talkative.
Anagallis (tds) : Cross and irritable, wanders aimlessly.
 Bewildered and confused.
Apocynum can. (tds) : Unable to sleep due to restlessness.
Aranea diad. (tds) : Wakes with arms and legs feeling swollen and
 heavy. Extreme coldness day and night. Poor
 sleep.
Arnica mont. (tds) : Sleepless and restless when over-tired.
Arsenicum alb. (tds) : Weakness and exhaustion worse each night.
 Periodical burning pains with cold skin and
 extreme anxiety. Mental restlessness.
Belladonna (tds) : Hot red skin with a flushed face, dry mouth
 and throat. Excited mentally. Restless sleep.
 Acuteness of all senses.
Calcarea carb. (tds) : Restless sleep at the time of periods.
Cantharis (tds) : Anxiety and restlessness ending in rage.
Causticum (tds) : Nocturnal tearing pains in bones and joints.
 Loss of energy. Restless legs at night.
Chamomilla (tds) : Peevish and restless with colic, specially in
 children.
Coca (tds) : Nervousness and nocturnal restlessness during
 teething.
Coffea cruda (tds) : Great nervous, agitated sleeplessness.
Iodium (tds) : Fever with flushed cheeks. Apathetic.
 RESTLESSNESS—RHEUMATISM—RICKETS 579

Kalium brom. (tds) : Restless sleep of nightmares. Grinds teeth in
 sleep.
Magnesium mur. (tds) : Sleeps during the day but restless at night
 because of heat. Horrible nightmares.
Natrium carb. (tds) : Anxious and restless during a thunderstorm.
Passiflora (bd) : Restless and wakeful resulting from
10-20 drops in ½ cup of water exhaustion.
Phosphorus (bd) : Restless and fidgety. Wakes up frequently
 during the night. Depressed and over-sensitive.
Pulsatilla nig. (tds) : The first sleep is restless. Tired in the
 afternoon, wide awake in the evening.
 Thirstless, peevish and chilly.
Rhus tox. (tds) : Extreme restlessness. Constantly changing
 position. Joints are tender and aching. Great
 apprehension at night. Muscular restlessness.
Secale cor. (tds) : Insomnia with restlessness. Fever with anxious
 dreams.
Tarentula his. (tds) : Extreme restlessness. Must constantly keep
 busy or walk and keep in constant motion,
 though, walking aggravates the troubles.
Zincum met. (tds) : Depression with restlessness. Coldness and
 spinal weakness. Restlessness during periods
 and menopause. Keeps the feet in constant
 motion, cannot keep them still.

 RHEUMATISM
 (SEE 'GOUT')

 RICKETS
 (SEE ‘BONES’)

 This disease is due to deficiency in intake of vitamin D which is found in
milk. Sunshine is a good source of vitamin D. Children suffering from this
580 RICKETS—RINGWORM

disease have abnormalities in shape and structure of their bones. The usual
symptoms are restlessness and slight fever at night, free perspiration about
the head, enlarged liver and spleen, delayed dentition and badly formed teeth.
There maybe nodules on the ribs. Long bones are curved. Some bone
deformities may require surgery. Excessive use of vitamin D in infants over
20000 I.U. and in adults 100000 I.U. daily is dangerous.Vitamin D is made in
the skin when it is exposed to ultervoilet rays from the sun.The body needs this
vitamin to maintain normal calcium levels and to build bones. Ultravoilet rays
are present in the morning when the sun is still rising and is red in color.

 RINGWORM
 (HERPES CIRCINATUS)

Aethiops merc. : Crusted ringworm.
mineralis 2x (tds)
Apis mel. 1000 (hs) : Ringworm with itching and burning, better by
 cold applications. Give one dose only.
Bacillinum 200 (hs) : One dose should always be given at the
 commencement of the treatment. No other
 medicine should be given for 24 hours.
Chrysarobinum 3x (tds) : Vesicular ringworm.Foul smelling discharge
 with crust formation. Violent itching. Thighs,
 legs and ears mostly affected. Scaly eruptions
 around eyes and ears with pus beneath.
Cod liver oil : Application of the plain oil at bed time on the
 affected skin has proved to be very useful in
 removing the madening itching.
Dulcamara (tds) : Ringworm of the scalp. Thick brown crusts
 which bleed on scratching. Ringworm on the
 face, genitals and hands. Eruptions appear red.
Graphites 200 (hs) : Eruptions oozing a sticky liquid, which is
 honey colored. Worse in the bends of limbs,
 groins, neck and behind the ears.
Hepar sulphuris (tds) : When the disease extends to the forehead, face
 and neck. Worse in dry cold winds.
Hydrocotyle Q (bd) : Dry eruptions. Great thickening of the skin.
 RINGWORM—SACRUM 581

10 drops in ½ cup of water Scales. Psoriasis in circular patches on the
 trunk, extremities, palms and soles.
Kalium sulph. 6X (tds) : Ringworm of scalp or beard with abundant
 scales.
Radium brom. (tds) : It is better in open air and worse in bed and
 while undressing. Circular patches itching in
 bed and burning.
Rhus tox. (tds) : Ringworm oozing an offensive moisture with
 violent itching. Ringworm of the scalp in
 children extending to the face, neck and eyes.
Sepia (tds) : Ringworm is worse in open air and cold
 weather. Ringworm on mustaches. Itching not
 relieved by scratching. Eruptions every spring.
Sulphur (od) : It maybe used off and on during the treatment
 of diseases, if disease is not yielding properly.
 Also when there is acidity along with
 ringworm.
Tellurium met. (qid) : It is a remedy of great importance in the cure
 of this disease. It should be given 24 hours
 after the use of Bacillinum, four times daily. It
 is more indicated when the ringworm is on the
 face. The odor of the body and sweat is like
 that of garlic.

 SACRUM
Aesculus hip. (tds) : Aching aggravated by walking or standing with
 blind piles.
Aloe soc. (tds) : Drawing and heaviness aggravated in the
 evening with bleeding piles and diarrhea.
Baptisia (tds) : Pain in sacrum, around hips and legs. Sore and
 bruised, worse humid heat, indoor or in fog.
Berberis vulg. (tds) : Violent pains, aching, bruised, dragging or
 pressing aggravated by lying, sitting or
 stooping with rectal troubles.
Helonias (tds) : Sensation of weakness, dragging and weight

NOTE: Multiple sclerosis is a disease that erodes the layer of myelin from

10 drops in ½ cup of water absent or are in low count. Weak and thin

NOTE: Semen is a mixed product of various glands. Prostate gland secretes a
 thin and slightly alkaline fluid which forms a part of the semen.
 Spermatozoa are produced in the testicles and are stored in the seminal
 vesicles. A normal sperm count is 50-200 per cubic centimetre of
 ejaculate, out of which 80% should be mobile or moving.

 SPINE 625

 Pain in the lower back is the most common of all pain complaints. It is a
medical fact that once discs get injured, they seldom heal. Homeopathic
treatment has succeeded in several cases . In order to understand the problem,
it maybe understood that the spine is the weakest but the most important part
of the body. It is made up of a column of bones that are called vertebrae. One
on top of the other, they cover and protect the spinal cord. The spinal cord is a
part of the nervous system attached to the brain that controls all the body
functions. In between each vertebra is a disc which is made up of a jelly-like
substance known as the nucleus. Nucleus is covered with many strong outer
layers called annuals. The discs function as shock absorbers to protect the
bones and surrounding nerves. Unlike other organs of the body, the discs do
not have blood vessels to nourish them. Discs depend upon fluids rich with
oxygen and nutrients passing back and forth from the bones above and below
them. The fluid exchange depends upon the difference of pressure between the
inside of the discs and blood vessels in the bones around them. When the
pressure drops inside the disc, fluids and nutrients rush in. This is why all disc
nutrients and regeneration takes place while lying down when pressure is taken
off the discs. Wear and tear of the disc takes place greater than its ability to
heal and regenerate. With advancement of age, the annual layers become weaker,
causing injuries including repeated scarring. This weakens the annuals which

nerves and loss of sensation in the skin. Following repeated injury, discs dry
out, scar and degenerate over time thus losing their shock absorbing properties,
and pressure is exerted over bones and joints leading to arthritis.

 completely.

How bacterium attacks the stomach
The discovery of Helicobacter pylori, a bacterium commonly found in human stomach
changed how doctors think about ulcers. The bacterium may also provide clues in hu-man migration patterns.
How the bacterium operates in the stomach
The worm-like H. pylori bacterium enters the system through the mouth
and moves to the stomach, where it thrives. There, its chemical system
neutralizes stomach acid and its hair-like flagella allow it to swim down
into the mucous layer next to the stomach lining, above. It attaches
itself to the cells of the lining and causes inflammation. A small percent-age of people with the bacterium develop ulcers.

stress can cause insomnia, migraine, ulcers, fibromyalgia , immune system

syndrome and irritability. Along with the treatment described below, the stress
can be reduced by the following ways:

chapters.title: Section 28 (Pages 676-700)

648 STRESS

1. Add more fun to your life - do things you enjoy and enjoy what you do.
 Persue a hobby. Gardening is a soothing exercise. Go on a vacation.
2. Get enough sleep and rest - your body should recharge and discharge
 tensions.
3. Laugh often. Laughter is a great tension breaker and it enhances the immune
 system. Rent a funny movie, read a funny book or TV show that makes
 you laugh and keep it on hand for stress emergencies. Watch a comedy
 movie.
4. Regular exercise is a great way to relieve tension, increase energy and
 improve the mood. Find an activity you like and do it often. Going for a
 walk clears the mind.
5. Love more - learn to use things and to love people, instead of the other
 way around. Helping others through voluntary work takes attention away
 from anxieties.
6. Eliminate self pity - you may get sympathy for a while, but soon you will
 get avoided.
7. Develop a meaningful relationship. It is important to have good friends in
 whom you can confide and find support. It is also important to be a true
 friend. Talk to such friends.
8. Alter behaviors and attitudes - when ideas or views are not serving you
 well - change them. Learn to respond to situations, not react. Compromise.
9. Learn relaxation techniques like meditation, yoga, etc. to experience inner
 peace.
10. Express your feelings. Do not suppress your emotions as it can create
 stress, pain and illness.
11. Nicotine, alcohol, caffein, sugar and refined carbohydrates should all be
 eliminated from consumption. These substances rob the body of stress
 fighting vitamins B and C, potassium, zinc and magnesium.

 THYROID GLAND
 Thyroid gland is situated just below the larynx and just above the windpipe.
Thyroid disease either under production (hypothyroidism) or over production
(hyperthyroidism) of hormones is often hereditary and is on account of a
defective immune system, stress or changing hormone levels.

Three steps control the way your thyroid gland functions:
1. First, hormone released from your hypothalamus travels to your pituitary gland (see
diagram). This hormone signals the pituitary gland to release another hormone. Thyroid
Stimulating Hormone (TSH).
2. Second, TSH travels from your pituitary gland to your thyroid gland. TSH triggers
your thyroid gland to make the hormones thyroxine (T4) and triiodothyronne (T3).
3. Third, thyroid hormones T4 and T3 are release from your thyroid gland into your
bloodstream. T4 and T3 travel throughout your body and regulate the rate at which
many different organ systems work.
Hypothyroidism results when your thyroid gland is underactive—it does not produce
enough thyroid hormones for your body to function at the right level. Some of the
symptoms of hypothyroidism include fatigue, weight gain and intolerance to cold. Treating
hypothyroidism is simple. Medication can replace the thyroid hormones your body is
missing.

 A lack of sufficient production makes the body use energy slower and it
results in easy weight gain, tiredness, forgetfulness, dry coarse hair and skin,
heavy menstruation and constipation. It can cause cholesterol levels to rise or
trigger depression.
 Over-production makes the body use the energy faster and causes
nervousness, irritability, bulging eyes, scanty menses, diarrhea and warm moist
palms. It can cause heart rhythm irregularities and osteoporosis.
 Goitre or swollen thyroid gland can occur in both the forms of the disease.

696 TUMORS

 TUMORS
 (SEE ALSO ‘CANCER’)

 Normal cells reproduce themselves throughout life but in an orderly and
controlled manner. Normal growth occurs, worn out tissues are replaced and
wounds heal. When cells grow out of control and form a mass, the mass is
called tumor. Some tumors grow and enlarge only at the site where they began
and these are benign tumors. Other tumors not only enlarge locally but have
the potential to invade and destroy the normal tissues around and to spread to
the distant parts of the body. Such tumors are called malignant or cancerous.
Distant spread of a cancer occurs when malignant cells detach themselves
from the original (primary) tumor, are carried to other parts of the body through
blood or lymphatic vessels and establish themselves at the new site as a cancer.
A tumor that has spread in this way is said to have metastasized and the
secondary tumor or (tumors) is called metastasis. However, not all the localised
growths are benign and not all the growths occuring at different sites are
malignant. Genes are the blue prints that tell a cell when to divide and when to
die. Often when a gene turns bad, it triggers uncontrolled growth, but genes
called tumor suppressors step in to stop it. It is when these tumor suppressors
also turn bad, that the tumor develops.

 hour or so, it renders the voice clear and silvery.

chapters.title: Section 31 (Pages 751-775)
chapters.content:
VOICE - LOSS—VOMITING 723

Carbo veg. (tds) : Loss of voice with hoarseness after a
 debilitating disease.
Causticum (tds) : It is worth trying for loss of voice whether from
 psychological or inflammatory causes, when
 there are no other symptoms for accurate
 prescription. Loss of voice due to a defect in
 the larynx
Coca Q, : When a singer or a public speaker experiences
5-6 drops every ½ hour loss of voice during singing or speaking, give
 5-6 drops every half an hour, about two hours
 before the expected demand on the voice.
Croton tig. (tds) : There is complete loss of voice from drinking
 cold water or cold beverages, when over-heated.
Ferrum pic. (tds) : Voice fails after public speaking or singing.
Phosphorus (bd) : Loss of voice with laryngitis and constant
 hawking.
Populus candicans Q (tds) : It is a remarkable voice restorer, restores
 almost instantly. It removes hoarseness and
 dryness of the larynx and pharynx, rawness and
 soreness of the throat and tones up the voice.

 VOMITING
Aethusa cyn. (tds) : Vomiting after drinking milk.
Amygdalus per. Q (tds) : Very useful in all kinds of nausea and vomiting
 or morning sickness or vomiting in pregnancy.
 Children do not digest any kind of food which
 is vomited out.
Antimonium crud. (tds) : Vomiting after eating or drinking due to
 indigestion. After nursing, the child vomits
 milk in curds, refuses to nurse afterwards and
 is very cross.
Apocynum can. Q (bd) : Excessive vomiting. Nausea with drowsiness.
 Food and water is immediately ejected. Dull,
 sinking feeling in the stomach. Oppression in
724 VOMITING

 epigastrium and chest with difficulty in
 breathing.
Apomorphinum Q (hs) : The chief power of this remedy is that it
 produces vomiting. 25 drops in a little water
 will cause full vomiting in 5-15 minutes.It is
 used when some poison has been swallowed
 and is still lying in the stomach.
Aquilegia vulg. (tds) : Vomiting after menopause or hysterical
 vomiting.
Arsenicum alb. (tds) : Vomiting of all kinds of foods and drinks due
 to acidity, specially after eating and drinking.
 Vomiting maybe easy and voilent. Diarrhea
 may occur with vomiting.
Belladonna (tds) : Incessant, uncontrollable vomiting.
Carbolicum acidum (tds) : Constant belching, nausea and vomiting of
 dark olive green matter. Vomiting due to a
 cancer in esophagus or stomach.
Cina (tds) : Vomiting with worm symptoms.
Cocculus ind. (tds) : Vomiting during travelling by bus or car.
Crotalus hor. (tds) : Vomiting after menstruation.
Euphrasia (tds), : Clearing throat of mucus in the morning causes
Bryonia alba (tds) vomiting.
Ferrum met. (tds) : Vomiting immediately after eating.
Geraninum (tds) : Relieves vomiting in gastric ulcers. Give half
 dram dose, thrice daily in a little water.
Hydrophobinum (tds) : Vomiting at the sight of running water.
Ipecacuanha (qid) : Good for all kinds of vomiting.
Iris vers. (tds) : It is a good remedy for the habitual vomiting
 of babies.
Kalium bich. (tds) : Vomiting after drinking beer.
Nux vomica (tds) : Vomiting in the morning after drinking whisky
 at night.
Phosphorus (tds) : Vomiting after an operation.
Plumbum met. (tds) : Continuous and violent vomiting of food or of
 greenish or yellowish or blackish matter with
 VOMITING—VULVA 725

 violent pains in the stomach and abdomen.
 Vomiting of bile or blood. Vomiting of fecal
 matter. Colic, constipation.
Pyrogenium (tds) : Coffee ground color of vomit.
Symphoricarpus 200 (bd) : This is a routine remedy for cure of persistant
 vomiting of pregnancy and nausea during
 menstruation. Nausea is worse by motion.
Sepia (tds), : Vomiting during pregnancy.
Colchicum autum. (tds)
Stannum met. (tds) : Smell of cooking food causes vomiting.
 Sensation of emptiness in the stomach.
Staphysagria (tds) : Vomiting due to insults inflicted upon her.
Thyreoidinum 3x (tds) : Vomiting of pregnancy. Give a dose early in
 the morning before the patient gets up.
Valeriana (tds) : Vomiting due to anger in nursing women. Child
 vomits curdled milk after nursing.
Veratrum alb. (tds) : Thirst for cold water which is vomited out as
 soon as it is swallowed. There is violent
 retching with cold perspiration on the forehead
 during and before vomiting.

 VULVA
Bromium (tds), : Emission of flatus from the vulva.
Lac can. (tds),
Lycopodium (tds)
Copaiva off. (tds) : Inflammation of vulva with itching.
Eupionum (tds) : Sore pain between labia during urination.
 Swelling of labia. Pruritus vulva.
Kalium iod. (tds), : Burning of vulva.
Sanguinaria (tds)
Plumbum met. (tds) : Eczema of vulva.
Urtica urens (tds) : Herpes labialis, burning and itching.
726 VULVODYNIA—WALKING

 VULVODYNIA
 Vulvodynia is the pain of the vulva which is so uncomfortable that woman
cannot enjoy sex and her refusal to do so often ends in the breaking of her
relationship with her husband. It plagues millions of women and is not
understood properly. Many assume from the burning and itching that it is a
yeast infection although there is no yeast present. The following remedies have
given wonderful results:
Apis mel. (tds) : Swelling of the vulva with stinging pains worse
 by heat and touch.
Arsenicum alb. (tds) : Pain with burning, which is relieved by
 application of warm water.
Sepia (tds) : Violent stitching pain travels up from vulva to
 vagina and is worse from washing and cold,
 and better by pressure and warmth of the bed.
 Aversion to coition as the pain eclipses desire.
Sulphur (od) : Burning and itching worse by the heat of the
 bed, washing and bathing. Better by drawing
 the legs up.

 WALKING
Acidum phos. (tds), : Walks slowly without a reason and easily
Gelsemium (tds) makes missteps and stumbles.
Argentum nit. (tds) : Walking unsteady and staggering when not
 noticed.
Baryta carb. (tds), : Child is slow to learn walking.
Calcarea carb. (tds),
Calcarea phos. (tds)
Causticum (tds) : Patient is slow in learning to walk. Unsteady
 walking and easy falling.
Coffea cruda (tds), : Walks fast and quickly without any reason.
Sepia (tds)
Conium mac. (tds) : Sudden loss of strength when walking.
Crotalus hor. (tds) : Walks on tip toes.
 WALKING—WARS 727

Heloderma (tds) : When walking, lifts feet higher than usual and
 brings them down with a thud.
Kalium phos. (tds), : Walks half-consciously in sleep.
Silicea (tds)
Lacticum acidum (tds) : When walking, trembles all over.
Lac can. (tds) : When walking, seems to be walking in air.
Lachesis 200 (hs) : Knees knock against each other while walking.
Repeat after a week
Lathyrus sat. (tds) : When walking, heels do not touch the ground.
Lathyrus sat. (tds), : Must stoop when walking.
Mezereum (tds)
Magnesium carb. (tds) : Suddenly falls to the ground while walking.
Manganum acet. (tds) : Cannot walk backwards without falling
 forward. Walks stooping forward. Peculiar
 slapping gait. Walks on metacarpo-phalangeal
 joints. Walks on toes.
Medorrhinum 200 (hs) : When walking legs feel heavy like lead. Cannot
Repeat after a week walk on soles. Walk on the heels.
Nux vomica (tds) : Drags feet while walking.
Oxytropis (tds) : Staggering gait. Walks backwards.
Silicea (tds) : Scrofulous, rachitic children with a large
 abdomen. Slow in walking, night walking,gets
 up while asleep.
Thuja occ. (tds) : Legs feel heavy, as if made of wood or glass.

 WARS
Aconitum nap. (tds) : A soldier becomes nervous on taking part in a
 war for fear of death or other horrors of war
 and is reluctant to fight. A dose of this remedy
 will remove his fears and nervousness.
Argentum nit. (tds) : By the use of this remedy, anxiety on account
 of air raids is diminished.
Arnica mont. (tds) : Any person who has been too close to the site
728 WARS

 of a bomb explosion and is not hurt, but feels
 fear and anxiety, will be comforted by a dose
 of this remedy.
Arsenicum alb. (tds) : Sleeplessness due to fear of air raids is cured
 by this remedy.
Borax 3x (tds) : Voilent fright from the sound of a firing gun,
 even at a distance.
Convallaria maj. Q (bd) : Palpitations and impending heart failure of the
 aged from a sudden explosion of a bomb.
 Extremely rapid and irregular pulse.
Hypericum Q (bd) : For healing the wounds produced by gun shots
 and after the lead has been take out surgically,
 apply externally and take orally for injuries of
 the nerves.
Ignatia amara (tds) : Fear and anxiety of air raids is removed by the
 use of this remedy.
Iodium Q (bd) : It is a powerful and harmless remedy to keep
 gun shot wounds clean and disinfected when
 used locally.
Kalium iod. 1x (tds) : It protects the thyroid gland in case of an
 accidental release of radioactivity from the
 nuclear stations. People living near, in about a
 10 kilometre radius of nuclear generating
 plants, should keep such tablets handy in their
 houses and take them as soon as possible, after
 the radiation leak, in order to avoid permanent
 damage to their thyroid gland and they should
 move to a far off place quickly.
Phosphorus (od), : Removes bad effects of the radiations on acco-Strontium carb. (tds) unt of an atom bomb explosion.
Symphytum off. Q (tds), : When the bones have been pierced by gun
Trillium pend. Q (tds) shots which have been removed surgically, take
 Symphytum Q internally and apply Trillium
 pend. Q externally to arrest bleeding.
Thallium (tds) : Loss of hair due to an atom bomb explosion.
 WARTS 729

 WARTS
 (PAPILLOMA)

Acidum phos. (tds), : Black warts.
Sabina (tds)
Acidum salicylic. 3X (tds) : Itchy and pustular warts. Scratching gives
 some relief.
Anacardium ori. (tds), : Warts on the palms of the hand.
Dulcamara (tds),
Natrium mur. (tds)
Anagallis 1x (tds) : It possess power of softening flesh and
 destroying warts.
Antimonium crud. (tds) : Warts on soles, palms and neck. Warts soft
 and smooth.
Antimonium tart. (tds) : Warts on glans penis.
Arsenicum alb. (tds) : Warts on the right hand.
Arsenicum alb. (tds), : Warts on the back of the hand.
Natrium carb. (tds)
Aurum mur. (tds) : Warts on the tongue and genitals.
Calcarea calcinata 3x (tds) : It is a remedy for all kinds of warts.
Calcarea carb. (tds) : Red warts on the fingers.Warts on face and
 hands.
Calcarea fluor. 12x (tds) : Hard wart or a mole on the scalp.
Cannabis ind. (tds), : Warts situated on the prepuce.
Acidum phos. (tds)
Carbo animalis (tds) : Warts on hands and face of old people.
Castor equi (tds) : Warts on breasts.
Castoreum (tds) : Warts on forehead.
Causticum (tds) : Warts on finger tips, right index finger, on the
 face, eyelids and in or outside the nose.
 Burning and bleeding easily. Maybe situated
 all over the body.
Dulcamara (tds) : Warts on the lower eyelid of the eyes. Large
 smooth warts on the palms.
730 WARTS—WATER

Ferrum met. (tds), : Warts on the left hand.
Psorinum (tds)
Ficus carica (tds) : The fresh milky juice obtained by breaking the
(Fig) stalk when applied externally on warts causes
 their disappearance.
Kalium crb. (tds) : Warts on the fingers.
Natrium carb. (tds) : Warts on forearms.
Natrium mur. (tds) : Warts on palms.
Natrium sulph. (tds) : Red warts on the whole body. General remedy
 for warts specially when fingers and toes are
 affected.
Nitricum acidum (tds) : Warts are like cauliflowers on lips or anywhere;
 hard, having cracks, sometimes emitting a fetid
 fluid. Warts on genitals. Warts bleed on
 washing.
Ruta (tds) : Warts on the inside of hands.
Sarsaparilla (tds) : Warts around joints of fingers.
Sepia (tds) : Warts situated on the whole body.
Thuja occ. 1M (hs) : Warts on the anus, thumb, sides of the fingers
Repeat after a week and the left index finger. Warts in crops,
 sometimes oozing moisture or blood.Warts on
 genitals and anal surfaces.
NOTE: A mixture of Thuja Q, Anagallis Q and Ficus carica Q in equal parts is
 mixed in a little amount of vaseline to make a paste. It can be applied
 locally on the wart, along with dispensing of the oral remedy.

 WATER
Ammonium carb. (tds) : Great aversion to water. Cannot bear to touch
 it.
Calcarea carb. (tds) : Aversion to water and washing as it aggravates
 ailments. Affections caused by working in
 water like those of washermen or
 washerwomen.
Ferrum met. (tds) : Sight of flowing water causes vertigo.
 WATER—WEAKNESS 731

Hydrophobinum (tds) : Dread of flowing water.
Hyoscyamus nig. (tds) : Dislikes water as he cannot swallow liquids.
Laurocerasus 1c (tds) : On drinking water or other liquids, it rolls
 audibly through the esophagus and intestines.
Natrium sulph. (tds) : Complaints due to water, like living in damp
 basements or near rivers, lakes and sea.
 Symptoms worse in rainy weather. Cannot eat
 any seafood like fish or even plants growing
 near water.
Sepia (tds) : It is called washerwomen’s remedy, because
 the ailments worsen due to laundry work.
Sulphur (od) : Dislikes water. Aversion to being washed.
NOTE 1: An average person needs about 8 glasses of water per day in summer
 and half this amount in winter. Water can suppress appetite, help reduce
 fat deposits, rid the body of harmful salts, help kidney flush toxins
 from the body, regulate body temperature, prevent constipation and
 keep the skin hydrated and glowing. It is one of the most important
 catalysts in losing weight and keeping it off.
NOTE 2: Every other substance becomes heavier, smaller and denser when it
 changes from liquid to solid, but water expands and becomes lighter,
 so much so that ice floats. Water is the only substance on earth that
 occurs naturally in 3 states of matter - liquid, solid and gas.

NOTE 3: Water is required by the body to moisten all the tissues and cells.

 WEAKNESS (DEBILITY)
Aceticum acidum (tds) : Prostration after surgery and use of anesthesia.
Acidum mur. 3x (tds) : Debility during low and septic fevers.
 Involuntary stools while passing urine.
Acidum phos. Q (bd) : 5 drops of it in a tumblerful of water as a
 beverage along with meals, for debility by loss
 of vital fluids, sexual excesses and
 disappointed love. Debility both sexual and
 physical, with depressing emotions.
Aletris far. (tds) : Debility due to prolapse of uterus.
732 WEAKNESS

Argentum nit. (tds) : Debility of calves. Walks and stands
 unsteadily.
Arnica mont. (tds) : Muscular fatigue due to over-exertion or due
 to injuries.
Arsenicum alb. (tds) : Debility resulting from over-taxing the
 muscular system by exercise, etc.
Arsenicum iod. 3x (tds) : General weakness. Tendency to faint. Loss of
 appetite. Thrice daily after food, with an
 interval of a day or two after a week of its use.
Avena sativa Q (bd) : Debility after exhausting diseases.
Cadmium sulph. (tds) : Exhaustion of mind and body. Declination to
 work after chronic post-influenzal states.
 Extreme prostration in low forms of diseases.
Calcarea carb. (tds) : Debility in fat children.
Calcarea phos. 6x (tds) : Debility after acute diseases, over-work, worry
 or depressing emotions.
Carbo veg. (tds) : Debility without fever, with blueness and
 coldness. A lowered vital power from loss of
 fluids or after drugging. Debility in old people
 due to disintegration and imperfect oxidation.
China off. 1M (hs) : After profuse bleeding during delivery, a dose
 of it will help recover the strength of the
 patient.
China off. 1x, (tds), : From loss of blood or other animal fluids
Curare (tds) like semen or leucorrhea.
Cinchona rub. Q (bd) : Nervously run down women are benefitted by
 the use of this remedy.
Colchicum autum. (tds) : Prostration and feeling of internal coldness as
 an effect of hard study or night watching. A
 peculiar symptom of this remedy is that the
 patient complains of prostration and weakness,
 trouble though he looks well.
Conium mac. (tds) : General debility of body and mind - most felt
 in the morning while in bed. Feeling as if
 bruised by blows. Gout, trembling and sudden
 WEAKNESS 733

 loss of strength while walking.
Conium mac. (tds), : Great debility in the morning in bed. Debility
Lycopodium (tds), of aged people.
Baryta mur. (tds),
Natrium mur. (tds)
Curare (tds), : Debility of the aged people.
Ambra grisea (tds),
Baryta mur. (tds)
Ferrum phos. 6x (qid) : Debility due to anemia. Tired feeling in the
 brain. Depression.
Ginseng (tds) : Removes weakness and produces sense of
 general well being.
Hamamelis Q (bd) : Weakness from loss of blood from open and
 painful wounds.
Helonias (tds) : Debility, dragging in sacrum and pelvis.
Iodium (tds) : Great unaccountable sense of debility. Little
 effort induces perspiration. Loss of breath on
 going upstairs. Feels better for the time being,
 during eating.
Kalium carb. (tds) : Muscular debility combined with weakened
 condition of the nerves. This makes him very
 sensitive. He is easily frightened, shrieks about
 imaginary appearances, cannot bear to be
 touched and startles when touched.
Kalium phos. 6x (tds) : Debility from mental strain.
Lathyrus sat. (tds) : Debility after influenza and other diseases.
Lecithinum 3x (tds) : Acts as a tonic during convalescence and in
 anemia. Removes symptoms of general break
 down and tiredness. Improves health.
Natrium carb. (tds) : Debility due to summer heat.
Natrium mur. 200 (od) : Weakness of the spine. Mental and physical
 debility. Weakness of the limbs like half
 paralysed extremities. Physical and mental
 labor is prostrating. Most weakness is felt in
 the morning.
Natrium sal. (tds) : One of the best remedies for the prostrating
 after-effects of influenza.
734 WEAKNESS —WEATHER

Psorinum (od) : Debility after acute diseases such as typhoid.
 Chilliness. Desire to lie down.
Selenium met. (tds) : Mental and physical weakness in old age.
 Debility due to summer heat and after
 exhausting diseases. Weakness after exercise
 and in hot weather. Strength rises as the sun
 sinks.
Silicea (tds) : Prostration of mind and body. Want of grit or
 grit all gone. It builds up such persons, raises
 spirits, revives hopes and weakness, depression
 gives way to the feeling of returning strength
 and health. Debility of thin, rickety children.
Strophanthus (tds) : Severe prostration from hemorrhage after
 operation and acute diseases.
Syphilinum 1M (hs) : Weakness and all other symptoms, pain, etc.
 are worse from darkness to daylight, sunset to
 sunrise, decrease and increase gradually. Utter
 prostration and debility in the morning.
Thyreoidinum 2x (tds) : Weakness, sensation of faintness and nausea.
 Sensitive to cold. Weakness after acute
 diseases. Easy fatigue, weak pulse, palpita-tions, cold hands and feet, chilliness and low
 blood pressure. Specially indicated in patients
 with thyroid troubles.
Veratrum alb. (tds) : Cardiac and general muscular depression and
 weakness. A good heart tonic.

 WEATHER

COLD WEATHER

Antimonium sulph. (tds) : Winter cough with soreness all over the body.
Argentum nit. (tds) : Cannot withstand hot weather and very cold
 weather.
Arsenicum alb. (tds) : Skin diseases becomes worse during winter.
Aurum met. (tds) : All complaints worse in cold weather and when
 getting cold. Many complaints come only in
 winters.
 WEATHER 735

Cuprum met. (tds) : Asthma worse cold weather, cold wind and
 dampness.
Dulcamara (tds) : Complaints worse during rains in winter.
Hepar sulphuris (tds) : Modalities worse from cold, dry winds.
Mercurius sol. (tds) : All complaints are worse during winter rains
 and dampness.
Nux vomica (bd) : Cold, coryza or snuffles from exposure to cold,

Petroleum (tds) : Diseases are worse in cold weather.
Silicea (tds), : All symptoms are worse in cold weather.
Petroleum (tds)
Terebinthiniae 1x (tds) : Winter coughs, bronchitis and sub-acute
 inflammation of the respiratory tract.Makes
 expectoration easy.
CHANGE OF WEATHER

Bryonia alba (tds) : Its action is most marked at the start of warm
 weather after cold days.
Calcarea carb. (tds) : Takes cold at every change of weather,
 especially fat persons.
Calcarea phos. (tds) : Diseases are worse during change of weather.
Chelidonium (tds) : Ailments brought on or renewed by change of
 weather.
Colocynthis (tds) : It is often indicated in the transition season
 when the air is cold and sun is still powerful
 enough to heat blood.
Psorinum (od) : Diseases are worse during change of weather.
Rhus tox. (tds) : Rheumatism is worse during storm, spring and
 changing weather.
HOT WEATHER

Aconitum nap. (tds) : Complaints of very hot weather, specially
 diseases relating to digestion.
Aethusa cyn. (tds), : Diarrhea and indigestion during summers, spe-China off. (tds) cially of children.
736 WEATHER

Antimonium crud. (tds) : The patient feels exhausted during warm
 weather and his gastric troubles increase in the
 hot season.
Argentum nit. (tds) : Cannot withstand hot weather and very cold
 weather.
Bryonia alba (tds), : Diarrhea in summer after over-eating.
Nux vomica (tds), Nux vomica diarrhea is worse in the morning
Pulsatilla nig. (tds) and Pulsatilla diarrhea is worse at night.
 Bryonia covers almot all dyspeptic ailments
 during summer heat.
Croton tig. (tds) : Summer diarrhea and skin affections.
Geraninum Q (tds) : 10 drops a dose, three times a day in summer
10 drops in ½ cup of water complaints generally.
Natrium carb. (tds), : Debility due to summer heat.
Selenium met. (tds)
Picricum acidum (tds) : It is a hot weather or summer remedy.
 Prostration and tired feeling. Aversion to food.
 Feet cold, cannot get warm.
Podophyllum (tds) : Diarrhea of children during summer and after
 eating acidic fruits.
Rhododendron ch. (tds) : Rheumatism and gouty symptoms worse in hot
 weather and before a storm.
SPRING WEATHER

Colocynthis (tds) : Troubles spring after winter - transition season
 when the air is cold but the sun is powerful
 enough to heat the blood.
Natrium sulph. (tds) : Skin troubles return every spring.

RAINY WEATHER

Blatta orient. (tds) : Asthma is worse in rainy weather.
Dulcamara (tds) : Aggravation of skin troubles during rains and
 damp climate.
Hepar sulphuris (tds) : Strong amelioration of respiratory diseases in
 damp weather.
Mercurius sol. (tds) : All complaints worse from damp, cold and
 rainy weather
 WEATHER—WEEPING—WEIGHT 737

Natrium sulph. (tds) : Aggravation of asthma and other respiratory
 troubles in rains and dampness. Every change
 of dry to wet has an effect. All troubles worse
 during rains.
Rhododendron ch. (tds), : Pains and all other symptoms are worse during
Rhus tox. (tds) winter rains and dampness.

 WEEPING
Manganum acet. (tds) : Involuntary laughter and involuntary weeping.
 Makes fun of other’s gait.
Medorrhinum (tds) : The patient cannot speak without weeping and
 speaks hurriedly. The patient looses thread of
 conversation.
Natrium mur. 200 (od) : The patient is secretive, holds her secrets,

Pulsatilla nig. 200 (od) : A mild, timid, reserved and yeilding patient,

Sepia 200 (od) : The patient dreads to be alone and is easily

Stannum met. (tds) : Patient is sad, despodent, discouraged, anxious

 WEIGHT
Alfalfa Q (tds) : 10 drops taken thrice daily produces more fat

Arsenicum alb. (tds) : Gradual loss of weight due to impaired
 nutrition.

 reduces weight, flesh and obesity. Patient eats

738 WEIGHT—WENS

Kalium hydriod. (tds) : Gradual loss of weight due to fungoid diseases.
Lecithinum 3x (tds) : Improves nutrition and increases flesh and
 weight.
Phytolacca dec. (tds) : Decrease of weight due to grandular diseases.
Natrium mur. 30 (tds), : Losing weight gradually due to over-work,
10M (hs) disappointment and suppressed menses.
Tuberculinum (hs) : Loss of weight due to respiratory diseases and
Repeat after 15 days enlarged tonsils.

 WENS
 (SEBACEOUS CYSTS)

 A cyst resulting from the retention of secretion of the sebaceous gland;
rounded, varying in size from the size of a pea to the size of a walnut. May
appear anywhere on the scalp, face, back, etc. It is soft and painless.
Baryta carb. (tds) : For recurring cysts around the eyes.
Benzoicum acidum (tds) : In gouty subjects with strong smelling urine.
Calcarea fluor. (tds), : Cysts on the eyelids.
Nitricum acidum (tds)
Conium mac. 200 (od) : Cysts of breasts.
Graphites 200 (hs) : It is one of the best remedies for persons prone
 to eczemas and other skin troubles.
Hepar sulphuris (tds) : Suppurating wens.
Kalium iod. (tds) : Wens in the scalp.
Phytolacca dec. (tds) : Granular swelling with heat and inflammation.
Thuja occ. 200 (od) : Soft fleshy excrescences and spongy wens.
 Cysts on the covered parts only.
Vanadium 6 (tds) : Cysts of arteries in brain and liver. Such cysts
 are filled with fatty matter secreted by the oil
 secreting glands of the skin, and are generally
 found on the scalp.
 WHISKERS—WHITLOW—WHOOPING COUGH 739

 WHISKERS
 (SEE ALSO ‘BEARD’ AND ‘BALDNESS’)

Arsenicum iod. (tds) : Eczema of the beard and moustache. Eczema

Baryta carb. (tds), : For falling of hair from whiskers.
Calcarea carb. (tds),
Kalium carb. (tds),
Sphingurus mar. (tds)
Graphites (od) : Ringworm of moustaches.

 WHITLOW
 (SUPPURATIVE INFLAMMATION AT THE
 END OF A FINGER OR TOE)

Ledum pal. 200 (od) : Abscess on the finger tip caused by a thorn,

 WOUNDS

 For healing a wound, three factors are necessary :
1. Cleanliness : For this purpose, the dirt, sand, splinters, small
 pieces of glass, etc. should be removed and
 the wound should be washed with cold water
 to which a few drops of Calendula Q have been
 added.
2. Dressing of the wound : It is important to bring the sides of the wound
 together and to exclude the air. It can be done
 by stitching if the wound is large or by applying
 pressure with fingers. Thereafter a lint dipped
 in Calendula Q should be placed over it and a
 little cotton be placed on the lint. Then bandage
 it tightly to keep the ends of the wound
 together.
3. Bleeding : If the wound is bleeding profusely, the bleeding
 should be stopped before step no. 2. A bandage
 should be tied above the wound to the side of
 the heart tightly. It will stop bleeding.
 Thereafter a lint piece dipped in Trillium pend.
 Q should be applied over it as in step no. 2.
4. Healing : When the wound has healed and stitches, if
 applied, have been removed, a paint of
 Sunflower oil on the scar and around acts like
 Arnica and removes swelling, bruises and like
 Calendula is an antiseptic.
5. Surgery : In deep and dangerous wounds, help of a
 surgeon should be obtained. The following

NOTE: My own experience shows that wrinkles can be prevented to a great extent
 by using the following tips:
 1. Massaging the face with an upward motion from the cheeks to the
 forehead.
 2. Vitamin E mixed with any oil should be used for the massage.
 3. Onion juice mixed with honey is an excellent anti-wrinkle paste.
 Before application, the face should be washed with soap and water,
 and dried.
 4. Plenty of rest and sleep helps to keep the looks young and fresh.
 5. Scientists have long known that sunlight can cause skin to wrinkle
 and turn leathery. Skin damage is caused by ultra-violet solar rays
 which are absorbed by urocanic acid, a natural molecule, made by
 the outer most skin cells. Sun rays chemically change this molecule
 making it free of oxygen thus degrading collagen and elastin, which
 are the major molecules that make the skin. Elasticity of the skin is
 reduced making a person look older than he is.
 6. Bananas have anti-wrinkle properties apart from making the skin
 soft and supple. Mash a quarter of banana into a creamy paste and
 apply it on the face. Leave it for about 20 minutes and then rinse the
 face alternately with warm and cold water to boost the blood
 circulation. Instant softening of the wrinkles and lines will not be
 able to escape notice.

NOTE : Here are some tips as how to feel mentally young and psychologically
 fit in senior years:
 1. Maintain regularity in life by getting up early in the morning,
 taking a bath regularly and eating at regular intervals. Break the
 boredom by eating out at a reputed restaurant once in a while.
 2. Exercise the brain by reading or listening to books on subjects
 which were liked in the younger years. Keep busy.

748 YOUTHFUL LOOKS

 3. Keep company of stimulating and agreeing younger companions.
 This can have positive effects on mental sharpness and happiness.
 4. Do not start feeling lonely, bored or unhappy. These feeling make
 one sick. Weather permitting, going out for a short walk or
 watching a movie, breaks such feelings.
 5. Cosmetic laser surgery can also bring about youthful looks by
 removing bags and lines from eyelids,wrinkles and sun damaged
 skin of the face, removal of unwanted hair, reshaping of lips, nose,
 breasts, buttocks, etc.
 6. Body has an enzyme called Telomerase. It is also called
 “Immortality enzyme” in layman’s language. It encourages cells
 to keep dividing indefinately instead of dying with age. It is said
 that it does not turn healthy cells into malignant or cancer cells.
 In course of time, homeopathic researchers may develop potentised
 telomerase which may prove as an anti-aging agent.
 7. Antioxidants slow down the aging process. Vitamins C and E, and
 beta-carotenes are primary sources of antioxidants and are
 obtained from fruits, nuts, vegetables and polyunsaturated oils.
